name: The old sun
description: Another sun, usually less benevolent and/or powerful, existed before the present one

name: Several suns burn the earth
description: The world was (almost) burned when several suns had (will) appear(ed) simultaneously. (Texts with "Moon was equal to Sun" without "the burned earth" motif not mentioned)

name: Extra suns and moons annihilated
description: Other suns or moons besides present ones had been in the sky and were later annihilated

name: The last sun
description: Two or more suns shine in the sky. When the extra suns had been annihilated, there was a risk of the last one being destroyed too

name: Extra suns are children of the present one
description: Extra suns who almost burned or could burn the world are children of the present one

name: Suns of the other worlds
description: Different suns illuminate different worlds or will appear successively in the future

name: Male sun and female moon
description: The Moon is female or bisexual, the Sun is male

name: Female sun
description: The Sun is female, the Moon is male or (much more rare) also female

name: The Sun dazzles eyes
description: Modest Sun-woman dazzles (usually pricks with needles, i.e. the sun rays) eyes of those who look at her

name: The Sun is afraid of the night
description: Being afraid of the night, the Sun decided to travel across the sky only at the day time

name: The Sun and the Moon are males
description: The Moon is male, the Sun is also male or (much more rare) asexual

name: The Sun created from the Moon’s swaddling clothes
description: The younger brother (usually the Sun) is created from urine and swaddling clothes of the elder brother (usually the Moon).

name: The Sun and the Moon are females
description: Both the Sun and the Moon are considered to be females (incl. cases when the gender is not directly specified but both emerge from parts of the body of a female person)

name: The sun pursues the moon
description: The Sun and the Moon are persons of different sex. The man pursues the woman or vice versa. Details of pursuit usually explain why the luminaries are not equally bright and/or why there are stains on the lunar disc

name: The Sun, the Moon and the Star are three siblings
description: The Sun, the Moon and the star (stars) are three sisters or three brothers

name: The moon defends people
description: Female moon does not permit her husband or son to destroy people

name: The sun finds its eyes
description: The sun gets his bright eye or eyes from an animal

name: Eyes of the Sun and the Moon: coolness and night
description: Visible sun and/or moon are the Sun's and/or the Moon's eyes. If these eyes were not injured, light and heat would be more intense

name: One-eyed luminaries
description: The Sun or the Moon have only one eye (the Mundurucu: they are blind)

name: The Sun, the Moon and monster’s eyes
description: The Sun and the Moon kill a monster whose eyes are unequally bright. The Moon takes the brighter eye but gives it back to the Sun

name: Eclipses: a monster’s attack
description: Some creature or creatures regularly (sunrise and sunset, summer and winter, lunar phases) or irregularly (solar and lunar eclipses, eschatological events) attack the luminaries or shade their light

name: Eclipses: a predator animal
description: During an eclipse or at the sunset the Sun or the Moon are attacked by a predator animal (a bear, a feline, a canine, a racoon)

name: Eclipses: a frog or toad
description: During an eclipse or at the sunset the Sun or the Moon are attacked by a frog or toad

name: Eclipses: reptiles and fish
description: During an eclipse or at the sunset the Sun or the Moon are attacked by a reptile (a snake, a lizard, a dragon, a crocodile) or a fish

name: Eclipses: birds
description: A bird or birds attack or shade the Sun or the Moon during an eclipse or at the sunrise and sunset

name: Eclipses: spider
description: A spider produces the lunar eclipses

name: Eclipses: creditor
description: A creditor comes from time to time to the Sun or the Moon to claim back his money producing eclipses

name: Raven steals the Sun
description: Raven steals (hides) the Sun or tries to do it

name: Raven obtains the Sun
description: Raven obtains the hidden or stolen Sun

name: Ants shade the Sun
description: During an eclipse or during the first night ants shade or shaded the Sun

name: Eclipses: relations between the Sun and the Moon
description: Coming together of the Sun and the Moon is the reason of their eclipses

name: Eclipses: crossing of the paths
description: An eclipse happens when the Sun or the Moon turns to a wrong path or when their paths cross

name: Dangers along the Sun’s way
description: Every night the Sun and/or the Moon passes by creatures or objects which try to destroy them

name: The Sun’s relax at the midday
description: After passing half of the its way across the sky (in the day time) or in the underworld (in the night time), the Sun stops to have a rest

name: The sky boats
description: The Sun and/or the Moon regularly travel across the sky or the underworld in a boat. (Voyages by boat of the mythical persons who eventually become the Sun or the Moon not included)

name: By horse in the morning, by ox in the evening
description: During its everyday travel across the sky, the Sun changes its draught animals (usually in the morning the Sun rides a slow animal and in the evening a quick one)

name: By snail in summer, by bird in winter
description: For its sky voyage, the Sun chooses draught animals according to the season, riding a slow animal in the summer time and a quick one in the winter time

name: Childhood of the Sun and Moon
description: The Sun and Moon are two siblings who live on earth and then ascend to the sky. Their (birth and) childhood are described

name: Luminaries thrown up into the sky
description: The sun and/or the moon are inanimate objects thrown up or put into the sky

name: To the sky from a bonfire
description: After getting into the fire or boiling water, one or two persons ascend to the sky and turn into the Sun and/or Moon

name: The hot Sun and its cold companion
description: After two persons burn up, one turns into the present Sun and another into a less important sky object

name: Hot fire and cold ashes
description: Person who becomes the Sun burned up in a hot fire while his companion burned up in the less hot fire or threw himself into the ashes. He (she) turns into the Moon or a star which gives no warmth

name: Person sacrificed to the Sun
description: To make the Sun rise above the horizon, to send him to the right distance from the earth, to make him move across the sky, etc. a person has to be sacrificed

name: The burned up persons turn into constellation
description: The burned up persons turn into a constellation or into the dark spot on the Milky Way

name: Elections of the Sun to be
description: The primeval ancestors come together to choose the best candidate to become the Sun and/or to send the Sun to the sky or to see how the Sun rises to the sky for the first time

name: Who will see the Sun first?
description: Two persons or animals argue about who of them will be the first to see the rising sun. One who seemed to have less chances wins

name: First beams on the tree tops
description: Two persons or animals argue who would see the rising sun first. One who looks not to the east but to the opposite direction gets to see the first beams on trees or mountain tops and wins

name: Who will fly higher?
description: Birds argue who of them will fly higher. One who seemed to have less chances wins (he hides himself in feathers of a strong bird using it as a vehicle)

name: The first sunrise
description: In the beginning it is dark. When the Sun first appears on the sky, primeval beings or part of them perish or turn into animals or spirits

name: The first day or night: transformed into spirits
description: At the moment when the first day or the first night come, (some) people turn into supernatural beings

name: Getting accustomed to the light
description: When people see light of day for the first time, they are prohibited to look at it immediately. Those who break this taboo are ruined

name: The Sun-bird
description: A bird incorporates the Sun or the day light. It can be caught, let free, killed

name: Crowns of the Sun and Moon
description: Light and/or heat of the Sun and/or Moon originate from their crowns, necklaces or clothes (of feathers, of animal teeth)

name: The Sun and a demon compete for the hero
description: Two persons one of whom is connected with the upper and another with the lower or middle world, both are eager to possess another person and pull him or her to his or her side. One or both rivals are female. Person connected with the upper world and/or the object of the competition are luminaries – the Sun, the Moon, or Venus

name: Torn in half by two wives
description: The sky wife and the wife from the earth each pull the man to her side tearing him in half

name: The Moon torn in half
description: Person, connected with the upper world and another person connected with the lower world or the earth both are eager to possess a hero or heroin who is associated with the Moon

name: The Moon eats the dead
description: Moon descends to earth to eat children, corpses or bones of the dead

name: The incestuous Moon
description: As a result of some intimate contacts and/or love affair, the Moon acquires its present appearance (often, the stains on his face) and/or ascends to the sky

name: The cut off breast
description: When a woman gets know that her husband or lover did something against accepted rules of behavior, she cuts off her breast and shows it to him

name: Figure on lunar disc
description: A figure or an imprint of some being or object are seen in the Moon. (For statistical analysis motifs A32A – A32J are also included into A32)

name: The Moon rabbit
description: Rabbit or hare are seen in the moon

name: The Moon toad
description: Frog or toad are seen in the moon or the Moon is associated with them

name: A man and a dog in the Moon
description: A human being and a dog together are seen in the moon

name: Man in the Moon
description: Human being or imprint of human being is seen in the moon

name: Firewood-carrier in the moon
description: Person who carries a bundle of brushwood or firewood is seen in the moon.

name: Person with an object in hands
description: Person who holds some object in his or her hands is seen in the moon

name: Water-carrier in the Moon
description: Person who went to fetch water and/or holds in hands a container for liquid is seen in the moon

name: Holding a bush
description: Person who had been carried up to the moon took hold of a bush or a small tree and is seen now on the lunar disc together with this bush

name: The Moon plant
description: A tree or bush is seen in the moon

name: A shepherd in the moon
description: A shepherd or herdsman (alone or with a girl, with his herd, dogs) is seen in the moon

name: A shaman in the moon
description: A shaman with his drum ascends to the moon and remains there, his figure is seen in the moon

name: First to the Sun, then to the Moob
description: Person seen in the Moon initially had to get to the Sun or the Sun and the Moon argue who of them should get the person

name: The Sun ram
description: The Sun has appearance of one a hoofed animal (bull, ram, pig, etc.)

name: The fox and the Moon
description: Jackal, coyote, or fox are connected with the Moon (usually with the origin of spots on the lunar disc)

name: Spots on the lunar disc
description: Dark spots on the lunar disc are dirt, blood, paint, traces of beating, burning, scratching, etc. on the Moon person's body or face (Kiliwa: spots on the Sun) and do not form any particular figure

name: Dirt into the Moon’s face
description: Spots on the lunar disc are dirt thrown into the Moon's face by his/her sister/brother or mother

name: To smear the Moon with pitch
description: To make the Moon less bright, some person tried to smear it with pitch

name: The immortal Moon
description: Moon, unlike people, revives or rejuvenates every month; or those who live in the Moon are immortal; or the Moon makes decision if people should die forever or regularly revive

name: The Sun is attacked
description: Person attacks the Sun (or several suns if they were many) with weapon

name: Shooter hides underground
description: Small animal (marmot, rabbit, mole, toad, frog) or person who turns into this animal tried to hit the Sun with arrows and since then has been hiding from the Sun in underground holes or in the water

name: Shooter’s thumb cut off
description: Small animal (marmot, rabbit, mole, toad, frog) or person who turns into this animal tried to hit the Sun with his arrows but remains without thumb as a result

name: The Sun caught in snare
description: Person prepares a snare, loop, noose, etc. to catch the Sun and/or the Sun is caught in a snare, tied by a rope, etc.

name: Snare of pubic hair
description: The Sun is caught into snare made of the pubic hair of hero's female relative

name: Mouse gnaws snare open
description: After the Sun is caught into snare only mouse, shrew or other small animal is able to cut it open

name: The Sun’s cloak
description: A boy or a girl has a cloak. The Sun spoils it or gives instead a better one

name: The Sun ruins cloak
description: Because the Sun does damage to a person or animal (spoils, burns his cloak, skin, etc.), the person or animal kills him or catches him in a snare

name: The twelve months
description: Every one of the months of a year is a separate object or creature

name: The Sun or Moon marry toad
description: Frog or Toad is a wife of the Sun or Moon

name: The Sun swallows her children
description: Two persons have children (younger siblings, mothers). One of them proposes to another that they should kill (eat, bake, etc.) their children (mothers, etc.) but hides his or her own. The opponent actually kills his or her own kin. One of the persons or/and the only survived child is the Sun

name: Phaethon: false Sun fails to fulfill his duty
description: Person comes to the sun, attempts to fulfill the sun's duty but intentionally or because of a lack of skill does it wrong and the earth suffers from heat etc.

name: The Moon in one moccasin
description: The Moon-person runs out of the lodge and flies up. He forgets to put his footwear on one foot, or somebody attempts to seize him grasping his foot or cuts the foot off. Now the Moon-person lacks one foot or footwear on one of his (or her) feet

name: Person with a shoe on one foot
description: While being transformed into a bird or ascending to the sky a person was in a hurry and put a footwear only on one foot, or somebody attempted to seize him grasping his foot. Now the corresponding bird or a sky-person is believed to have different feet

name: Moon the protector
description: A woman tyrannized by her husband or an orphan girl or boy asks the Moon to take her or him to the sky. The request is granted and the person is seen now on the lunar disc

name: The insulted Moon
description: Person who teases or insults the Moon is punished

name: The Sun and Moon from eyes of a being
description: The Sun and Moon (Rig-Veda: the Sun only) appear from eyes of a person or creature

name: Two male creators
description: In the beginning of times two companions or brothers compete in producing things. Usually one of them is or becomes master of the underworld

name: Three worlds: the universe divided between gods
description: Anthropomorphic persons agree to divide between them levels of universe (upper world, earth, lower world)

name: Two female creators
description: In the beginning of times two supernatural females compete in producing things. One has positive, another negative characteristics

name: One creator deceives another
description: Two creators agree that whose object will be found in a certain condition (usually: whose tree or flower will grow or blossom first) should be recognized as a senior one. While one of the creators sleeps or is absent, another replaces the objects and so achieves the priority by deceit

name: Good and bad workers
description: Two persons are creating the world, one is a good and and another a bad worker, that’s because separate parts of the world look differently

name: The female earth
description: The earth is a female being or associated with a woman

name: The earth eats the dead
description: The earth devours bodies of the people when they die and are buried

name: The earth as a child’s body
description: The earth as a whole or fertile soil is the body of a child, has been born by a woman

name: Marriage of the sky and the earth
description: The male Sky (the Sun, the Thunder, the creator of the sky) marries the female Earth (or its female creator) or the female Sky marries the male Earth

name: The male earth
description: The earth or the world as a whole is a male person

name: Buried in a head
description: Initially the earth is absent or liquid. Zoomorphic person buries his relatives in his own body or flies carrying the coffin

name: A primeval swamp
description: Initially the earth is a swamp, water and dry land are not separated from each other

name: Primeval waters
description: Water is the original element, the dry earth appears later

name: Earth grows big
description: Original earth was small and later increased in size or the fertile soil grew from a small amount of original substance

name: An attempt to drown God
description: When dry land is created, Creator takes a rest and sleeps. His antagonist decides to drown him and drags him to the edge of the earth. The dry land grows in size as long as the antagonist drags the Creator's body, the edge never reached

name: Earth from worm’s excrements
description: A worm obtains the earth (from the underworld), it emerges from the worm's excrements, is extracted from inside of the worm

name: Earth falls on waters
description: In the beginning there are only air and water. 1) Person descends from the sky, creates the dry land or a hard support created for her or him grows into the earth. 2) The earth is sent or dropped from the sky, put on the surface of the water. 3) The earth is brought from somewhere (not from the underworld) and put on the water

name: The fished out earth
description: Islands or continent are fished out of the ocean or pulled to their present place by rope

name: Two creators: a dialogue
description: In the beginning of time, a male and a female persons meet each other and become engaged into the dialogue

name: The universal mother
description: Woman (alone or with her companion) gives birth to or creates not only people but also different creatures and objects

name: First man and woman meets each other
description: The first or the only survived man and woman walk or run to each other around a post, a hill, etc. When they come together they marry each other

name: The spit out water
description: Somebody is the only possessor of water or certain beverage. Another person drinks it, escapes and spits out making it available for the people

name: Waters from broken pot
description: Sea, river, waters of flood flow out of a small container

name: Water splashed out
description: Person or creature possesses all the fresh water. Another person splashes it out of a container or pond making it available for everybody

name: Water flows from broken bone
description: Water flows from a broken bone (of a bird) producing a flood

name: Frog hides the water
description: Frog hides all the water but other person makes it available for everybody

name: Water in the tree trunk
description: There is enormous amount of water inside a trunk of a tree or a tree turns into water

name: Drunk out water
description: Person drinks a lake or all the water in the world or all the water is originally inside person's belly. When a hole is made in it, the water pours out

name: Mammoth creates the landscape
description: Mammoth described as an underground creature moves across the earth while it is still wet creating the present landscape

name: Stream follows person
description: A stream of water (with a monster in it) pursues person who tries to escape from it

name: Tears turn into water
description: Rivers, fountains, ocean, waters of flood, rain, etc. emerge from somebody's tears

name: River from woman’s body
description: A river flows from the body of a female person

name: Sea from the urine
description: Initially there is no sea, it is produced from some person's urine

name: Wolverine makes the sea salty
description: Wolverine or fox bathes in the sea making the water salty

name: Salt-grinding mill
description: Magic mill is ordered to grind salt but not ordered to stop. It sinks into ocean and continues to work making the water salty

name: Night in container
description: Darkness is a particular object that can be carried (usually brought from its original owner in a container)

name: Day in container
description: Day light (also warmth, the sun, the moon) is kept as a particular object in a container, under a cover, etc.

name: The night and the married life
description: People had trouble making love before night came into being

name: Expedition to the upper world
description: People regularly ascend to the sky for hunting, fishing or gathering; do not give honey, fish or proper meat to the old person remained below; she or he makes their return impossible, they remain in the sky

name: Destruction of the world tree
description: People ascend the tree to hunt, fish, or gather food in the sky. The tree is destroyed, people fall to earth or remain in the upper world

name: Offended person destroys the tree
description: People who have climbed up a tree do not share food with a person who remained below. He or she revenges on them destroying the tree. The events have cosmic dimensions

name: Lads and tapir
description: Boys climb a tree to eat fruits. Tapir asks them to give some fruits to him, they refuse to do so. Tapir tries to kill the boys

name: Prohibited fire and smoke
description: God prohibits making fire for cooking and punishes breakers of this taboo

name: Transformation of kinsmen into wild pigs
description: Person transforms into wild pigs his kinsmen or children

name: Circle of feathers
description: Person makes a circle of bird feathers around a group of people or throws feathers into their dwelling, people turn into wild pigs

name: Pigs fall from a tree
description: Persons climb a tree or liana and fall turning into wild pigs and other game animals

name: Man joins wild animals
description: Person who follows the wild animals turns into one of them or into their master

name: Variants of transformations
description: Persons ponders over what object, feature, or creature it would be appropriate for him or her to turn into. When the choice is made, the persons transforms himself or herself

name: Travelling transformer
description: The transformer walks along coming across different persons, transforming them into birds, animals, stones, shrines, etc. and introducing cultural norms

name: Pierced to the ground
description: Person who have been transforming people into animals or stones is pierced to the ground with a pole

name: Pacification of things
description: Hero comes to a country where inhabitants are afraid of objects or plants who attack them. He easily overcomes these objects and transforms them in what they are now

name: Lice grasp a man and pull him into the sea
description: Lice grasp a man and pull him into the sea

name: Man transformed into deer, his knives into antlers
description: Unrecognized Transformer meets a man who tells him that he prepares knives (a spear) to kill Transformer. The latter transforms him into deer, his knives or spear into deer antlers

name: Eschatological feast
description: People turn into animals, birds or stones at a feast, after the feast, after performing a ritual or after a victory over dangerous enemy

name: Murdered person turns into fish
description: Fish emerges from remains of a killed person or creature

name: Murdered person turns into game animals
description: Different game animals emerge from remains of a murdered person

name: Woman turns into water mammal
description: After a conflict with a man or remaining alone, a woman turns into water mammal

name: Women turn into fish
description: After a conflict with their husbands women turn into fish

name: Mother of wind
description: Female person is incarnation of wind, mother of winds, etc.

name: One dies of cold in the spring
description: Believing that a winter is over, an old woman (rare: a young girl, a man) goes outdoors (usually to graze her animals) without a proper clothing. It becomes cold again and she dies of cold

name: The offended March
description: Person teases, offends March or other month and is punished

name: A bird of march
description: In the late winter or early spring a bird (usually a thrush) flies out before time and dies of cold or her nestlings die of cold

name: The borrowed days
description: When the winter ends and the spring begins certain mother (usually March) borrows several days from a neighbor month to preserve its strength and produce a short period of a very cold weather

name: The old woman of winter
description: Old woman is incarnation of winter or there are several cold days between winter and spring (or fall) associated with a certain old woman

name: Overtaken by the first night
description: When night escapes from container where it was originally preserved, men surprised by the darkness turn into birds or animals

name: Waddling bear
description: Being in a hurry, the bear puts his left shoe on his right foot and vice versa. Now is lumbering

name: Tree fulfills wishes and then transforms into bear
description: Tree grants a man the fulfillment of his wishes but ultimately transforms him into a bear

name: Color, voice, form: one divided between many
description: Because the integrity of some creature or (rare) object is ruined, different beings get their present colors, voices and other anatomical traits

name: Bathing in blood
description: Birds or fish obtain their colors after smearing themselves with liquids extracted from the body of some being or dividing among themselves its bright skin or dress

name: Birds obtain their voices
description: Birds obtain their voices after pecking big reptile and smearing themselves with liquids from its body

name: Fat animals
description: Animals get meat and fat extracted from some original creature or created otherwise. Some get a lot, some remain lean

name: Color of birds
description: Person paints two or more different birds (rare: fish) or they paint each other, smear themselves with paint, decorate their bodies with pieces of bright skin or fabric. Since then feathers, beaks and feet of the birds (skin and scales of fish) are of different colors

name: The ruined painting
description: Person paints birds or animals or they paint each other. It is made not according to the original plan

name: Two birds paint each other
description: Two birds paint each other, one becomes worse than it was before

name: Raven and loon paint each other
description: Raven and loon paint each other

name: Tail base of the loon
description: Person kicks loon or other water bird. Since then this bird has flat tail base and it walks on dry land with difficulty

name: Raven and owl paint each other
description: Raven and owl paint each other

name: Swan marries crow
description: A bird with white or bright feathers marries a bird with black feathers but flies away after getting know that his or her marriage partner eats carrion or excrements

name: Narrow waist of an insect
description: Insect-person knows the source of food (cultivated plants) and water but does not share his knowledge. To make him speak, ancestors tie a rope around his waist and pull it till the waist becomes narrow (origin of narrow place between breast and belly of insects)

name: Rabbit as deer’s proxy
description: Hare or rabbit is a false deer or it was deer in the past or a close kin of the deer or had horns or antlers or missed opportunity to get them, its ears are the false horns

name: Missed opportunity to have horns
description: Animal who has no horns now had them before or missed opportunity to get them

name: Horse exchanges features with cow
description: The horse exchanges some parts of his body with the cow, usually gives her horns and/or obtains teeth

name: The talking dog
description: Dogs could speak. To prevent them to spread information, the dog is deprived of this ability or the dog rejects it itself

name: Animal reveals master’s secrets
description: The dog or other domestic animal speaks aloud about those details of its masters' life that they would prefer to conceal. He is punished by depriving his ability to speak

name: Cosmic hunt
description: Certain stars or constellations are interpreted as hunters, their dogs and game which the hunters pursue

name: Blood or fat drops to earth
description: Hunters pursue a bear across the sky, kill it in August – October. Its blood or fat drops to earth as a dew or painting leaves of the trees in red

name: Sky hunters pursue an ungulate
description: In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is an ungulate (elk, deer, mountain sheep, etc.)

name: Sky hunters pursue a bear
description: In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is a bear

name: Sky hunters pursue a tapir
description: In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is a tapir

name: Sky hunters pursue a rhea
description: In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is a rhea bird (Rhea americana)

name: Ursus major is an ungulate
description: Ursus major (seven stars or only four stars of a dipper) is identified with an ungulate (elk, deer, mountain sheep, etc.)

name: The object of cosmic hunt is the Belt of Orion
description: The object of hunt in the cosmic hunt tale is identified with the Belt of Orion

name: The object of cosmic hunt is the Lady in the Chair
description: The object of hunt in the cosmic hunt tale is identified with the Lady in the Chair

name: Cosmic hunt and the Pleiades
description: In the cosmic hunt tale either hunters or game is identified with the Pleiades

name: Animal is the dipper, hunters are the handle
description: Stars of the handle of the Big Dipper are identified with the hunters, the dipper itself with the game (bear or elk)

name: Second hunter’s cooking pot
description: Hunter identified with Mizar (the second star of the handle of the Big Dipper) carries a cooking pot identified with Alcor (weak star near Mizar)

name: The boaster and the hurried one
description: In the cosmic hunt tales according to which stars of the handle of the Big Dipper are three hunters, each of the hunters demonstrates particular psychological characteristics (one is a boaster, another is a hurried one, etc.). Usually these hunters are identified with peoples of different ethnic groups or with different species of birds

name: Orion is one person
description: Constellation of Orion or the Belt of Orion is identified with only one male person, usually with a warrior or hunter

name: Broken back constellation
description: Certain constellation is a male person whose back is broken or wounded

name: Ursa major is a bear
description: Ursa major is identified with a bear

name: Ursa major is a carriage
description: Ursa major is identified with a carriage, a cart

name: The Belt of Orion: one runs after another
description: Three stars of the Belt of Orion are three persons or animals who pursue each other

name: Hit with a projectile
description: Ursa major or Polaris are identified with a middle size animal (ermine, fisher, woodchuck) or person (identified with an animal?) hit with a dart or arrow

name: Ursa major is a big mammal
description: Seven main stars of Ursa major are interpreted as a figure of a mammal: bear, deer, mountain sheep, camel, dog

name: Purusha
description: Parts of the body of the primeval person or creature are transformed into different elements of the landscape and parts of the universe

name: Council on seasons: units of time
description: The number of discrete units of time in a certain calendar period of time is discussed

name: Council on seasons: toes, claws, hairs, feathers
description: Toes, claws, feathers, hairs, color stripes, etc. are counted and compared to establish the number of period of time or particular way of alternation of periods

name: Should warmth and light exist?
description: It is discussed if darkness or light, cold or warm periods should exist

name: Black-an-white animal is night and day
description: There are both night and day because spotted (or otherwise black and white) animal has been killed

name: Dispute of animals
description: Participants of the discussion concerning number of the units of time, etc. are animals (rare: animals and elements, in particular Wind)

name: Fox stands for day
description: In a dispute about should it be dark or light, Fox stands for light

name: Marriage of winter and summer
description: A coming of warm (light, abundant, etc.) or cold (dark, barren, etc.) time is related to the marriage of certain person

name: The bull of cold
description: Bull or cow are related to winter and cold, responsible for existence of the cold season

name: Ursa major as seven men
description: Every star of the Ursa mayor is a separate person. Usually the constellation represents seven men, rare it is seven women or seven persons and animals

name: Stolen star of the Pleiades
description: The seventh star of the Pleiades was abducted by stars of Big Dipper and now is seen among them

name: The Pleiades bring cold
description: In former times or regularly the Pleiades or other group of stars produced or produce till now severe cold. (The heliacal set of the Pleiades is in May-June while in the Northern Hemisphere they are seen best of all in the winter time)

name: Split hood of cow
description: Cow steps on the stars of the Pleiades which were dangerous being and lived on earth. Some of these stars slipped through its split hoof

name: Predators become herbivorous
description: Weak or herbivorous animals were dangerous predators but have been transformed

name: Other creatures’ flesh
description: Particular pieces of flesh or inner organs in the bodies of animals, birds, or fish originally belonged to other creatures

name: Human flesh in the animals
description: Some game animals have a piece of human flesh in their body that remained since the time when these animals were anthropomorphic

name: Muddled request
description: Animals of particular species do not hear well the instructions concerning their way of life or the ask God for some benefit but muddle their request. Thanks to this they acquire their present habits. (In the Toraja tale the motif is used to explain the mortal nature of human beings)

name: How many cubs in a year
description: Mighty animals lost opportunity to have many children and now give birth only once in several years

name: Bloodsuckser’s lie
description: An insect feeds on human blood (flesh). Dangerous person asks it where it got to suck blood or whose blood (flesh) is the most delicious. The insect lies or cannot answer (its tongue is cut off). Thanks to this dangerous person attacks certain plants or animals and not people

name: Mosquito and thunder
description: Bloodsucking insect does not tell thunder that it has sucked human blood

name: Snake and swallow
description: Swallow does not let snake to destroy people. Usually the snake sends mosquito or other bloodsucking insect to get know whose blood is the most delicious. The insect flies back to report that human blood is the sweetest. Swallow bites its tongue off and the snake gets to pull off feathers from the swallow's tail

name: Vulture creates the landscape
description: Flying above the earth and flapping its wings, a bird (usually a vulture) makes it dry after the flood or otherwise creates present landscape

name: Some earth is concealed
description: Person spits out earth that he swallowed or concealed otherwise. This way the broken landscape is created

name: Earth bigger than sky
description: When the earth and the sky were created, they p[roved to be of unequal size. The earth was squeezed, this way mountains appeared

name: Creatures or objects from cut off genitals
description: Supernaturally big genitals are cut off and turn into snakes or other creatures and objects

name: Chips turn into fish
description: Chips of wood, branches or pieces of bark thrown or fallen into the water turn into fish and/or aquatic animals

name: Leaves are fish
description: Fish grows on branches of a tree or leaves of a tree turn into fish

name: Fire tongue of crocodile
description: After the crocodile or caiman swallows or loses fire (that he possessed before), he remains without his tongue; or the crocodile's tongue is cut off to make something related to celestial fire (thunderbolt, sun beams, etc.

name: Blood reddens world
description: When some person or animal is killed, blood paints the sky or vegetation (origin of the sunrise or sunset, of reddish colors of Aurora borealis or of the red color of the autumn leaves)

name: Red sunset contains a message
description: When person gets to see that the sky becomes red he or she understands that another person's blood is shed or that another person spilled a red liquid

name: Wild turkey’s red neck
description: After the original fire is stolen by the ancestors, a partridge size forest bird (Penelope sp.; Anhima cornuta; etc.; jacu, paujil) swallows burning coal and (besides the Andoque) its neck becomes red

name: A groups of dancers ascend to the sky
description: A group of people (usually children, brothers or sisters) play, dance, ascend to the sky and turn into Pleiades or other compact constellation

name: Offended children abandon parents
description: Children conflict with their parents who do not pay them enough attention, condemn their sexual behavior, do not give them enough food, clothes, etc.; the children abandon their parents and become birds, bats, atmospheric phenomena, or stars (usually the Pleiades)

name: The mole’s paw
description: Mole had to support the sky or the Sun that had fallen down. Usually its paw (hand) remained crooked after this

name: Buzzard husband
description: Man thinks that buzzard or hawk has better life than he. They exchange clothes. The bird lives with the man's wife as her husband, the man usually does not enjoy his bird life

name: Transformation of lazy boys
description: Young people, usually siblings, tell other person, usually their mother, that they have been doing agricultural work though it is not the case. When the deceit is discovered, they turn into atmospheric phenomena

name: The bony fish
description: Bones of fresh-water fish are result of a fighting or military expedition. The bones are arrows that have pierced the fish bodies (gill openings are pierced by arrows) or the small bones are fragments of originally big ones

name: Small bones: war between fish and birds
description: Fish and birds shoot arrows into each other. Since then there are many small bones inside the fish

name: Small bones: war between different fish
description: Fish of two species shoot arrows into each other. Since then there are many small bones in the fish or some bones are forked

name: Small bones: fish fall from the sky
description: Fish in company of other earth dwellers ascend to fight with the sky dwellers. They fall to earth and break their bones. Since then there are many small bones in the fish

name: Bones in the birds’ leg
description: Small bones in the legs of birds of particular species or spots on their feathers are arrows shot into them from below

name: Intestines turn into creepers
description: Person plays imitating other animal person. His belly is cut open as a result and intestines turn into vines

name: Rope turns into creepers
description: Persons climb to the sky up a rope or an arrow ladder; fallen down rope turns into forest vines

name: Tree turns to rocks
description: People fell giant tree. The fallen tree and/or its stump turns into mountain(s) or rocks

name: The giant grouse
description: Hazel-grouse was big and dangerous. He is torn to pieces which are shared between other birds and animals. What remains is the present grouse

name: Chipmunk's back scratched: hence his stripes
description: (Animal)-person wants to thank or to punish small animal (chipmunk, ground squirrel, etc.) and scratches or paints it producing stripes on its back

name: Council on seasons, chipmunk participates
description: Chipmunk or an animal of similar size (weasel, pika) is engaged into argument with another animal person (bear, elk, puma, snake) if it should be warm and light or cold and dark

name: Ears of hare
description: Person beats hares, foxes or other medium size animals who became helpless (usually closed in his house). Tale explains why tips of the animals' ears or tails have a particular color

name: Aurora borealis
description: Aurora borealis is spirits (of the dead) who run holding burning torches, play or fight with each other

name: The thirsty cuckoo
description: Children do not give water to their mother or mother to her child. The offended person turns into a bird, usually a cuckoo

name: Mother, child and swans
description: (Step)parent does not share his or her food with a child. The child (usually a small girl) asks the migratory birds (swans, geese, etc.) to take her or him with them. The birds give the child feathers (wings, etc.) and the girl (boy) flies away with the birds

name: Offended one turns into bird
description: Children do not give water to their thirsty mother or mother (step mother, stepfather) does not give water to thirsty child. The offended one turns into a bird and flies away

name: The cuchoo: different legs
description: Person turns into the cuckoo so quickly that one of his or her legs remains bare or one of her braids not plaited. Now it is believed that the cuckoo has different legs or wings

name: The cuchoo: in search of lost horse
description: A girl (with her brother; two small brothers) is (are) in search of the horse or cattle or the girl is in search of her lost brother. She (alone or with her brother; both brothers) turns into a bird (usually a cuckoo; or both siblings turn into birds) that cries in specific way

name: The cuckoo: in search of lost sibling
description: Girl searches for her lost brother, calls him or brother calls his sister, or they call each other, or two lost brothers call each other. One or both siblings turn into birds with specific cry

name: The red-eyed wood-grouse
description: Eyes of wood-grouse became red because it shed tears

name: The marriage of the owl and the Moon
description: Owl had to separate with the Moon and since then cries when the Moon shines. Usually the (proposed) marriage of the owl and the Moon broke up

name: Sounds of the time of creation: a woman's voice (echo)
description: A certain woman lived in primeval time but her voice is still heard (usually she turns into echo)

name: Sounds of the time of creation: a creaking of trees
description: Man pushes his mother-in-law or his wife into a tree hollow, she turns into the creaking of trees or into echo

name: Sounds of the time of creation: a murmur of forest and waves
description: The murmur of leaves or waves of the time of creation is still heard

name: Waves turn into mountains
description: Waves of the sea petrified and turned into dry land with mountain chains

name: Primeval sky close to earth
description: Originally the sky was close to the earth, then it has risen up

name: Giant pushed the sky up
description: One or several (animal)-persons push sky up to its present height

name: Sky touched with a long object
description: The sky rose to its present height and/or the direct relations of the sky deity with the people were broken off when the sky or the deity was touched or struck with a long object (a pestle, a broom, etc.)

name: Sky touched with a pestle
description: The sky rose to its present height and/or the direct relations of the sky deity with the people were broken off when the sky or the deity was pushed up, touched or struck with a pestle or with a ladle during the preparation of food

name: Sky touched with a broom
description: The sky rose to its present height and/or the direct relations of the sky deity with the people were broken off when the sky or the deity was pushed up, touched or struck with a broom

name: Serpent pushes sky up
description: Serpent-like creature pushes the sky far away from the earth

name: Shaking bed makes snowfall
description: When person or creature shakes himself or itself, shakes his or her bed, clothes, plucks birds, etc., snow falls down to earth

name: Cosmic egg
description: From the primeval egg, eggs, or egg-like ball emerge the earth, the sky, sky bodies, different animals (all or part of the items of this list)

name: The bird lain an egg
description: In the beginning of time a bird flies, lays an egg or eggs, different objects and creatures emerge from them or a bird drops some solid substance on the waters and the dry land or an island appear

name: Measuring of the world
description: The process of world creation includes the measuring of its size

name: Rifle for dog
description: Creator and his opponent ponder upon should the dog be able to use a bow or fire-arms

name: The white raven
description: Raven or other carrion-eating bird of dark color and a similar size was originally white

name: Too heavy bag
description: Person tries to pick up a small object or creature but it proves to be of enormous size and weight

name: Fungi and excrescences (ogress transformed)
description: A female demonic person, usually while she is pursuing a man, dies and her flesh turns into objects that are found on trees, like fungi, pitch, fruits or nuts

name: Wind pacified
description: Wind is too strong and is pacified

name: Wind regulated
description: Wind blows in a wrong way, people can get no game or fish. When a hero overcomes it, it initially becomes too calm but the hero creates the desirable balance

name: Bag of winds
description: Wind was or is in a particular enclosure (bag, cave, etc.). It was released from it or comes out from time to time

name: Babylonian tower
description: To reach the sky, people build a ladder or tower that consists of separate modules (bricks, logs, sticks, etc.). This construction collapses

name: Alcor
description: Alcor (a weak star near the second star of the handle of the Big Dipper) is selected as a particular sky object

name: Alcor is a dog
description: Alcor is interpreted as a dog

name: A harnessed wolf
description: The handle of the Big Dipper is not straight because a wolf or a bear (identified with Alcor or with the last star of the handle, η) attacked an ox that was dragging a cart

name: Job
description: All person's children die. He or she addresses God and asks him why he or she suffers so much

name: Owl as a king of birds
description: Owl was or wanted to be king of birds or it behaved itself in a wrong way during the elections of the king. Now it avoids other birds and/or other birds chase it

name: Master of wolves
description: There is an anthropomorphic patron or patroness of wolves. Usually he or she gives instructions to wolves on particular day of the year

name: Sharp-eyed snail
description: Snail had (the) sharp(est) eyes. Another animal person borrows them and never returns

name: Flint turns into flints
description: Person who embodies flint or other hard stone is broken, stones disperse in the world

name: Sky bridge in the mid of summer
description: Once a year in the middle of summer sky dwellers or messegers of the deity who are at the opposite sides of the Milky Way come together. Usually birds make a chain of their bodies to serve as a bridge across the celestial river and feathers on the birds' heads become worn down

name: Talking trees
description: Trees and (domestic) animals could talk and asked people not to cut or kill them

name: Tree grants a wish
description: When a man has felled a tree or is going to cut it, the tree or a bird who lived in the trunk grants the man’s wishes

name: Burned bottom parts
description: Human posterior looks in particular way because certain person burned it

name: Pursuer turns into surgeon
description: Pursuing heroes, a monster falls into water, turns into a big fish or a water mammal

name: Kingfisher’s necklace
description: Thankful person decorates a bird who lives near water (kingfisher, loon, goose), thence its appearance (crest, beak, feathers)

name: Bat between birds and animals
description: Bat becomes outcast among other creatures usually after it makes attempts to join first animals and then birds or vice versa

name: Bat and funerals
description: Bat is in conflict with other creatures because of the incident related to somebody's death or funerals

name: Turned into nest of insects
description: Person abandoned in a tree turns into a nest of insects

name: Getting a sleep
description: Formerly or in a particular country the sleep was not known;

name: Slashes on birch bark
description: Angry against the birch, person beats or cuts it, whence scratches and slashes on its bark

name: Clouds from smoke
description: Clouds are formed from smoke that ascends from the earth

name: Cornel-tree fruits
description: Person (a devil or a bear) thinks that because the Cornus mas tree (European cornel, male cornel) blossoms before all other fruit trees do, it also brings its fruits early. The cornel fruits become ripe very late, so the person is disappointed and gets no fruits

name: Chicken turns into tortoise
description: When a guest comes, a host hides from him a cooked chicken. When the host is going to eat it himself, he finds the chicken transformed into the tortoise (origin of tortoises) or a toad

name: Daughter-in-law turns into hoopoe
description: Father-in-law gets to see his daughter-in-law when she combs or washes her hair. She is ashamed and turns into the hoopoe (origin of hoopoe)

name: The sky cock
description: When the sky cock cries, all the cocks on earth cry after him, not before

name: The black oyster
description: During a (world) fire oyster was burned, nor now oyster shells are black

name: Person turns into snow
description: Anthropomorphic person broken into small particles turns into the snow that shines under the sun

name: Person turns into bear
description: Person turns into bear (origin of bears)

name: Reversal of cosmic levels
description: The present earth or the underworld is the former sky that has fallen down, or the earth turned in the past upside down, or the layers of the universe collapsed in the past one after another, or they will change their place during the future cataclysm

name: Deluge and conflagration combined
description: World is destroyed once with fire or draught, another time with a flood or it is destroyed with a flood of fire or boiling water

name: Conflagration of the woodpecker
description: Two persons meet a woodpecker and as a consequence, the earth burns. The strong and smart person survives, the weak and stupid is burned

name: The burned Moon
description: The Sun and Moon get into conflagration. The Sun survives, the Moon is burned

name: Hole in arch
description: During the flood a hole is opened in the arch. An animal stops it up with its own body

name: The flood: fruits fall from a tree
description: During the flood or in the beginning of times fruits, seeds or other objects are dropped into water one by one, usually by a person who has climbed a tree. As far as the objects fall, water recedes and the dry land appears

name: Bird-scouts
description: Birds or humans who are later changed to birds are send to explore the earth (is it dry, are any survivals, to bring some dry soil, to investigate why smoke rises to the sky, etc.)

name: Animal-scouts
description: During the creation of the world or after the world cataclysm animals run around making the earth big, reporting about its condition or they are sent to report the size of the growing earth

name: The diver
description: Persons or animals dive to get something from the bottom of the water body

name: The diver is turtle or frog
description: A turtle, a frog, a toad, or an armadillo brings the desired object from the bottom of the water body or from the lower world

name: The diver is muskrat or beaver
description: A muskrat, a beaver or a nutria brings the desired object from under the water

name: The diver is a bird
description: An aquatic bird brings the desired object from under the water

name: Birds: successful and unsuccessful divers
description: Two or more different birds (often a loon and a duck) dive one after another to get earth from under the ocean. Only one of them is successful

name: The earth-diver
description: Persons or creatures get from the bottom of the ocean or from the lower world small amount of solid substance which turns into the earth

name: The diver is a crustacean
description: A crustacean brings the earth from the bottom of the ocean or from the lower world

name: Diving for drowned person
description: Persons or animals dive to get from under the water a drowned person or creature or part of its body

name: The diver is a wild boar
description: A wild boar brings the earth from under the water and/or spills it over the water

name: An insect brings the earth
description: An insect brings the earth (from under the water, from a lower world or from a far-away place)

name: The flood: breaking the dam
description: In the beginning of times or after the flood a dam of earth, person or creature does not let water to recede. The dam is broken or opened, waters withdraw

name: The primeval couple of siblings
description: In the beginning of time or after the world catastrophe brother and sister or mother and son are the only humans. They marry each other, present people descend from them

name: Grinding stones match
description: Being alone and having no other marriage partners, brother and sister agree to marry each other if a highly improbable event or a series of events will take place. Among the events that take place (alternatively or one after the other) are 1) the siblings let two grinding stones roll from two mountains, the brother's stone falls on the sister's one; 2) brother and sister throw two swords from two mountains, both swords get into one sheath; 3) they throw some objects up, the objects get together; 4) they kindle two fires, columns of smoke get together; 5) they put to grow two stems of bamboo, tops of the stems get together

name: Siblings change their looks and marry
description: In the beginning of time or after the world catastrophe brother and sister or mother and son are the only humans. They reject marriage or only the man does not want to marry his sister or mother. After their looks are changed (or only the sister or mother changes her face) they take each other for strangers, marry and beget the new race

name: The flood: people turn into toads
description: During a flood or when crossing a river those people who drown (or those who survive) turn into toads

name: The flood: the wet tails
description: During the flood birds or animals escape to some place (mountain, tree, boat, sky). Tips of their tails or other body parts get covered with water or foam and acquire their present color and form

name: The flood: birds cling to the sky
description: During the flood some birds survive clinging to the sky with their beaks

name: Father avenges his son
description: Person uses his supernatural powers to destroy a large group of people who have offended or insulted his son

name: The dog and the world cataclysm
description: A dog warns people about approaching flood or world conflagration, instructs them what should be done

name: People descend from a dog
description: In the beginning of time or after the flood man marries a bitch. Present people descend from them.

name: The objects’ revolt
description: During or before the world cataclysm (deluge, darkness) or (Suruí) in particular place at night, household objects and/or stones, trees, domestic animals turn into wild beasts and monsters

name: Monsters destroy people
description: During or before the world catastrophe (deluge, darkness) wild beasts and monsters attack and destroy people

name: Processed objects turn into animals
description: Against person's will, butchered, dried or cooked meat, tanned hides, etc. turn back into animals or fish and escape.

name: The offended mistress of animals
description: Mistress of animals or fish revives them after being offended

name: Fire pit for the people
description: The men of primeval community destroy most of the people and/or themselves in a fire pit or on the bonfire

name: Dance for the hidden Sun
description: Certain person hides valuables or the impersonator of the valuables hides himself or herself from the people. To get valuables, the interest of their owner or imperso­nator is attracted or diverted by way of singing, dancing, playing music, provocative behavior, offering of unusual gifts, sex or alcohol

name: Acquisition of the sun
description: The primeval ancestors acquire with difficulty the hidden or stolen sun or daylight. (for computing all cases for motif C19A are included into C19)

name: Child plays with the sun
description: Persons (usually Raven) turns into child, asks and receives to play luminaries or comes to play with a small daughter of the owner of the luminaries

name: Toad in search of thunder
description: In time of severe drought or the world conflagration birds and animals are sent to bring rain from Thunders who live at the end of the world. Some fail, the last one succeeds. Toad takes important part in the action

name: Tree eclipses sky-light
description: Growth and falling of giant tree defines the condition of the sky with luminaries on it (tree eclipses the light of the sun, can destroy the sky, tears the sun off the sky, etc.)

name: The world in danger of falling down
description: A tree or pillar supports the sky or the earth. If it collapses, people perish

name: Cooking soup in the Moon
description: The destiny of creation depends on a person (usually an old woman) who is cooking soup somewhere outside of our world (in the sky, in the Moon, etc.)

name: A spinner in the Moon
description: Somewhere outside of our world (in the sky, on the Moon, etc.) certain person is spinning, weaving, plaiting, or embroidering

name: The Bid Dipper and the end of the world
description: Change in configuration of the stars of certain constellation (usually Big Dipper) or its disappearance from the sky will be a signal of approaching world cataclysm

name: Guardian at the border of the non-human world
description: Monsters or ghosts try to invade our world. Powerful person or creature is on guard and prevents the invasion

name: A horn in the ice
description: A horned monster breaks ice on river or lake. Usually people walk across frozen body of water, get to see a horn protruding from the ice and try to cut it off. The monster breaks the ice, many people drown

name: Unconsidered promise
description: A demon obtains valuables essential for another person's (and for all the people) survival but is tricked to return the valuables

name: A listened in secret
description: People or God get know a secret thanks to listening in its possessor when he speaks aloud with himself or with his relations. Before this the wise person was usually asked to come and share his knowledge but was offended and went away

name: The smart hedgehog
description: A hedgehog proves to be smarter than other animals (life on earth is saved thanks to him, he deceives a dangerous person, etc.)

name: Beware of cut off nails
description: The cut off nails (and hair) have special significance for the fate of the soul in the beyond or for the future of the entire world

name: Prometeus (the chained strong man)
description: A strong man who ventured to confront God is for a long time (for eternity) chained to a mountain or to a post

name: Blacksmiths restore the chain
description: A strong man is enchained but his chains become ever thinner. When blacksmiths beat their hammers against the anvils the chain becomes thick again

name: The primordial calm
description: The primordial race perishes when the wind blows for the first time

name: Buried in sand
description: A supernatural person comes to people who fish. They bury him on the beach or throw him into river or marsh. Somebody saves him. He or his father sends the flood

name: Cosmic marriage cancelled
description: It becomes known that if the Sun or the Sky marry, great calamity is inevitable. The marriage plans are given up

name: Wise adviser punished
description: A zoomorphic person gives wise advise concerning the ways that the Sun should follow. His advise is accepted but he himself is punished by the Sun

name: The final battle
description: Gods fight with their powerful adversaries at the decisive battle that changes fate of the world

name: World catastrophe and the sloth
description: A sloth produces the world catastrophe or saves people from it

name: Female spirit of fire
description: Fire is personified as an (elder) woman, alone or with her husband, master of fire

name: Mother-in-law is the Fire
description: Girl marries man whose mother is Fire

name: Mistress of fire carries away woman’s baby
description: Because a woman offended the fire, its mistress carries the woman’s baby away

name: The borrowed object is not burned
description: House of a person who insulted the fire is destroyed but an object or a child of another person who was nice to the fire has not been burned though it was in the house of the first person

name: Male spirit of fire
description: The fire is personified as an elder man (alone or with his wife, mistress of fire)

name: Woman gives birth to the fire
description: A woman gives birth to a son who is very hot (usually the fire or Sun)

name: Theft of fire
description: Fire is stolen from its original owner or brought back to the people from somebody who had stolen it before

name: Moth is sent to steal fire
description: Moths try to get fire from people and to bring it to somebody else

name: Retribution for using fire
description: Person or people who have stolen fire or asked its owner to share the fire are punished by God

name: Acquisition of summer
description: Warm season is obtained from its original owners

name: Swimming elk diverts attention
description: Animal-people come to steal summer from its owner. One of them in guise of an elk or caribou diverts the owners' attention or puts to float a log that the owner takes for an elk and pursues. The summer is successfully stolen and brought to the people

name: Opossum steals fire
description: Opossum steals fire for people

name: Coyote or fox obtain fire
description: Coyote or fox bring people the fire, the daylight or the Sun

name: Dog obtain fire
description: Dog brings people fire

name: Beaver or fish let themselves to be roasted
description: Beaver (in North American) or a small fish (in South America) lets fire owners catch and roast it, then revives and carries the fire away

name: Hummingbird obtains fire
description: Hummingbird steals for people, discovers or spreads the fire

name: Swallow obtains fire
description: Swallow steals fire for people

name: Beaver obtains fire
description: Beaver steals fire for people

name: Rabbit obtains fire
description: Fire owner, stealer, or stealer's companion is a rabbit, a hare or (among the Ofaie) a guinea pig

name: Deer obtains fire
description: Dear steals fire for people

name: Fire from the sky
description: First fire is sent to earth from the sky or the ancestors ascend to the sky and bring from there fire or warmth

name: Fire owners dance
description: Person comes to the owners of fire or light. They feast and dance. He joins them and in a proper moment carries away the valuables

name: Person weeps asking for summer
description: A boy or (among the Kutenai) a woman weeps, asking for an element that is absent, i.e. for summer, fire, or rain

name: Fire stealer pretends to be wet and cold
description: To steal fire from its owner, person pretends to be wet or cold and is granted permission to sit near the fireplace. In a proper moment the stealer carries the fire away and brings it to people

name: Parrot or parakeet obtains fire
description: Parrot or parakeet steals fire for people. (Australian data not computed because historically definitely unrelated to the Tropical American data)

name: A woman and the
description: Female person is the owner or inventor (but not personification) of fire

name: Fire in woman’s genitals
description: First fire was hidden in genitals or anus of a woman

name: Fire and crocodile
description: Crocodile or cayman is an original or temporary owner of fire or lighting

name: Burned person becomes a caiman
description: Badly burned person turns into caiman or crocodile

name: Fire and toad
description: Frog or toad possesses the fire, steals it from original owner, tries to extinguish or to save it

name: Fire and a predator animal
description: Fire or summer is stolen from a big predator: a lion (in Africa), a tiger (in Asia), a bear (in Siberia and North America) or a jaguar (in South America)

name: Fire and vulture
description: Raven or other big dark-feathered bird scavenger is the owner, personification, spouse, obtainer or stealer of fire, daylight, or the Sun

name: Firesticks are two persons
description: A male and a female persons personify fire-sticks

name: Food baked in armpits
description: Before fire became known, people prepared food using warmth of their bodies (usually putting food in their armpits); or a person keeps fire in his or her armpits

name: Food baked in the sun
description: First people or inhabitants of a distant country cook food in the sun; or fire owner lies that he or she cooks food in the sun

name: Heat of the sun is enough for cooking
description: To cook their food, people use heat of the sun because they live close to its origin

name: Trickster makes his brother’s wife laugh
description: Two companions or brothers live together. The elder conceals his wife from the younger. In his absence, the younger tries to make the woman laugh and this way to get know her hiding place

name: To make hidden woman laugh
description: Woman is hidden somewhere inside the house. Man makes her laugh to discover her

name: Hunters laugh at killed animals
description: Hunters perish because they were laughing at the killed (and revived) animal

name: Laughter and fire
description: Laughter triggers emergence or spread of fire. Usually fire is obtained from a creature when it bursts out laughing

name: Meet seen on teeth
description: When person laughs, people see his or her monstrous mouth (many teeth, human meat on teeth). They kill the monster or escape from it

name: The dead should not laugh
description: Person should not laugh in the world of the dead

name: Not to laugh visiting the dead
description: Person who visits the other world should not laugh or demonstrate his surprise seeing strange and funny things

name: Broken tooth
description: Person knows that the deceiver and trickster has one of his teeth broken. To identify him, person makes others laugh and thus open their mouths

name: First people of unstable materials
description: First human beings are made of unstable materials (mud, wax, fire, honey, etc.) and unviable

name: Person of unfit materials
description: Certain person is made of improper material and proves to be short-lived or unfit for fulfilling his functions

name: Person of excrements
description: Certain person is made of human excrement or carrion

name: Canoes of clay
description: First canoes were made of unfit materials

name: People made for a test
description: Making people, creator does not reach perfection immediately. First variants of creation are rejected, then proper form and material found

name: New people from bones
description: After destruction of previous world, new people (rare: new earth) are made from the bones of the perished race

name: Creation from cuticle
description: Supernatural person rubs his or her skin, creates the entire earth, human or other beings of dirt and cuticle

name: Half-made man attempts to stand up
description: God makes the first man of clay. The man must wait till he is dried up but makes attempts to stand up before time

name: Mankind ascends from the underworld
description: First people (or only first men or first women) are not created but come to earth from the underworld or from a small enclosure under the earth or on its surface (tree trunk, rock, gourd, etc.). Many people of both sexes and of different age or people and different species of animals come out together

name: People grew like a grass
description: The first people grew or crawled out of the earth like a grass, mushrooms, worms, etc.

name: First couple from the underworld
description: First man or first human couple come out from the underworld or from a small enclosure on its surface (tussock, reed, tree, rock, gourd)

name: People from the sky
description: The first people or first anthropomorphic divine beings descend to earth from the sky.

name: Predator devours emerging people
description: People live underground or in a small enclosure. When they come out they are attacked by monster or dangerous animal. Monster is killed or transformed

name: The two-headed one is not allowed to come to the earth
description: First people or animals ascend or descend to earth. The two-headed monster attempts to follow them but is prevented from coming to the earth

name: Because of a woman worlds become isolated
description: When a woman of the child-bearing age tries to come from one world to another (e.g. from sky to earth), the communication between the worlds is blocked or broken forever

name: Way across waters
description: To reach their present country, people had to pass (frozen) water body. Part of the migrants remain on the opposite side or is drowned

name: Person stuck in a cosmic hole
description: To descend from the sky, ascend from the underworld or come out of the cave, people must pass through narrow hole. A person is stuck in the hole blocking forever communication between different parts of the universe

name: People of wood
description: The first people or (the first) woman (wife of a primeval ancestor) are made of wood

name: Women from coconuts
description: Coconuts picked off a palm or fallen to the ground (rare: leaves picked off a tree) turn into women or into both women and men

name: The mysterious housekeeper
description: A man (rare, a woman) lives alone. In his or her absence, somebody puts his or her house in order, prepares his or her meals or (rare) eats food up, makes a disorder. He or she discovers that a woman (a young man) lives unrecognized (in animal form, hiding in an object) in or near the house or comes during his or her absence

name: Fox-wife
description: Man maries fox-woman

name: Fox-wife in animals’ den
description: In search of his lost fox-wife man comes to a den. Different animal- or bird-women come out and ask him if he would mary them. He refuses and they let him in

name: Turtle-wife or snail-wife
description: The mysterious housekeeper is a water creature (turtle, snail, shellfish)

name: Elephant-, buffalo-, elk-wife
description: Man marries a woman who has a nature of a big non-predatory animal or comes out of its body (elephant, buffalo, doe, elk, etc.)

name: Dog-wife
description: Man marries dog-woman

name: Puppy as a reward
description: Youth gets to supernatural beings, rejects any treasure, asks for a puppy, a dog's skin, a fruit, etc. When he returns home, the puppy (skin, etc.) turn into magic wife

name: Parrot-wife
description: Man maries parrot- or parakeet-woman

name: Vulture-wife
description: Man marries vulture-woman

name: Dove-wife
description: A man marries dove-woman or a woman marries dove-man; supernatural woman or man takes form of a dove

name: Swan-wife
description: Man marries swan- (or goose-, duck-, crane-)woman; supernatural woman takes form of a swan, etc.

name: Monkey-wife
description: Man marries monkey-woman; supernatural woman takes form of a monkey or the man pretends that the house-keeper is a monkey

name: Spouse is honey (bee)
description: A man or a woman is incarnation of the honey or a bee-person

name: Pets turn into children
description: A lonely woman or married couple surprises birds or animals who live in their house and take their skins off when nobody looks at them. Birds or animals (usually pups) become children

name: The burned skin
description: Magic person reveals his true nature and/or remains with the real people after the object responsible for preserving the non-human appearance (usually an animal skin) is destroyed (usually burned)

name: Ritual objects from under the water
description: People obtain ritual objects from under the water or brings them back to the underwater world

name: Rituals from the dead
description: Rituals are obtains from ghosts

name: Masks represent the killed demons
description: People prepare ritual costumes and masks coping the features from the real demons whom they have killed

name: Ducks and canoes
description: People learn from aquatic birds how to make canoes or how to paddle; or the first canoe is a transformed bird or is made of bird bones

name: Breast bone as a canoe model
description: Frame of canoe is made according to breast bone of a bird

name: Birds sew canoe covering
description: While man is asleep, birds turn into girls and sew covering of his canoe

name: Paddles edgewise
description: Riding in canoe, people first turn paddles edgewise, then learn the correct way to use them

name: Origin of design
description: Humans acquire (the idea of) ornamentation of the vessels, baskets, body, etc. after somebody gets to see the pattern on the skin of zoomorphic and/or supernatural creature. Design on the objects copies (is an imprint of) a pattern on such a skin

name: Snakes and containers
description: People learn how to decorate ceramics or baskets (usually learn decorated patterns) thanks to a water creature

name: Origin of drugs: person torn to pieces
description: Narcotic plants emerge from the body parts of a person who was torn to pieces by others

name: Fish poison person
description: Entering water, certain person makes fish die. From parts of his body or from his grave grows plant used to prepare fish poison (timbo)

name: Avenged victim of water creatures
description: Child fishes with poison or his or her body produces fish poison. Fish or water snake kills him or her. The perished child is avenged

name: Swallowed person obtains knowledge
description: Getting into the body of certain being, person obtain knowledge of rituals, songs, ornaments, poison or drugs and then brings it to people

name: Fleas make person move
description: A handful of fleas or lice is thrown into people or into particular person. It was the only way to make him, her or them move and live

name: Origin of elbows and knees
description: Human arms and legs become pliant (get joints) when a primeval ancestor(s) fall from height and break his arms and legs

name: Fished out people
description: Man fishes with a hook. Thrown on the ground, the fish turn into the first humans or into the women. (Stories about fishing of women in human guise not included).

name: People from drops of blood
description: People emerge from drops of blood that fall from the sky

name: Lizard gives proper hands
description: Two persons (usually Coyote and Lizard) argue if people's hand has to be like a paw or people should have fingers

name: The make-believe spouse of wood
description: Person does not have a spouse, uses wooden fakes for his wife or her husband

name: Make-believe spouse replaced with alive person
description: Person does not have a spouse, uses wooden fakes for his wife or her husband till alive person comes to replace it

name: Pygmalion
description: Man makes a wooden doll, makes believe that it is alive. Really it is not or it is half-alive. Usually a real woman takes place of a doll, marries the master

name: Creators and rescuers of a girl
description: Several men take part in creation or reanimation of a girl (rare: a bird) or several women take part in the reanimation of a dead man or they differetly express their grief. It is asked whose role was crucial (who behavior more noble) and/or who should be the spouse of the reanimated person

name: Rescuers of a man
description: Several women take part in the reanimation of a dead man. They argue whose role was crucial and/or who of them should be the spouse of the reanimated person

name: People born from trees
description: First people are born by trees or come out of a tree, flower, reed

name: People from seeds
description: People emerge from grains, seeds

name: Sacred flutes from ogre’s remains
description: Ogre is killed. Musical instruments used in male rituals and taboo for women emerge from his remains

name: Webbed fingers
description: First people or people made by Creator's rival were imperfect, not completely anthropomorphic (often: had webbed fingers)

name: Hard covering of the body
description: Human body was protected with a hard layer now preserved only on fingers and toes as nails

name: Peoples from sticks
description: Creator takes many small sticks, transforms them into people of both sexes and all ages

name: Woman gives birth to many embryos
description: Woman gives birth to a gourd, a bag (with eggs), a piece of meat. The flesh is cut into pieces which turn into people or many people come out of the gourd or bag

name: People from gourd
description: After the world cataclysm or in the beginning of times a gourd survives or appears, new people come out of it

name: Pig ancestor
description: A pig is an ancestor of a particular group of people

name: Nostrils upside
description: First people have noses with nostrils upside and are in trouble when it rains

name: First woman is a transformed man
description: Woman or female supernatural is created by changing the sex of a man

name: Pregnant limb
description: Child is born from a tumor or swelling on person's body (on thigh, knee, finger, etc.) or is temporarily placed there or child grows from blood that flew out from a cut

name: Child born in jug
description: In the beginning of times, a particular person or children in general was or were conceived and grown up in pots, heaps of mud, etc. and not in a womb

name: Brides for first men
description: Person cannot or do not want to give his daughters in marriage to all the men who claim them for wives and transforms animals into girls. (Usually in the beginning of times or after the flood many men come to marry the only daughter of God or patriarch)

name: Artificial bride
