description: Person has to give his daughter or sister in marriage. Having no woman to suggest or not wanting to give her, he makes artificial girl (of wood, snow, etc.), sends servant girl instead daughter, turns into woman himself, or recognizes his fault when he feels that it is save to do so

name: Gouged our vagina

name: The water-maiden

name: Women and men come together

name: A dangerous woman

name: Snake inside woman
description: Poisonous snake (snakes, scorpions) comes out of the mouth of a woman {Motif F9f1 and K100c are almost identical but F9f1 links to a cluster of etiological/cosmological motifs related to the idea of a dangerous woman while K100c is related to adventures}

name: Hood of cobra in wife’s bag
description: Woman’s snake paramour is killed. She puts part of his body into her bag and gets a right to kill her husband if he woulod not guess what is inside. At the last moment the husband gets to know the secret and kills the woman

name: Brunhilde

name: Girls and the water spirits
description: For girls and young women it is dangerous to come near water. Water creatures swallow them or drag away; a girl can die or become pregnant from a spirit; she can trigger a flood (rare: other cataclysm). Water spirits can come themselves to a girl who has her periods

description: To kill snake or worm paramour of a woman or girl, person pours on it boiling water, resin or spills live coals

name: Snake paramour
description: Woman or girl takes eel, snake, lizard, or worm for paramour. People kill or badly injure the paramour, the woman and/or her progeny or the woman herself is transformed into snake

name: Worm-baby
description: Woman is nursing a worm, caterpillar or reptile as her baby. People kill the monster

name: The broken egg
description: Girl or woman is imperceptibly impregnated by snake when the content of a broken egg of a snake flows into her vagina or when she touches a dead snake

name: Tree fruits for a woman
description: Baby child or children who come out of mother's womb and turn themselves into adult men or a snake who lives in her womb climb up a tree and help the woman to gather fruits, bark, edible fungi, etc. Usually the child who is a snake returns to his mother's womb and adult man turns back into a baby; or the girl's love affair with a snake is discovered when her father climbs a tree to gather fruits for her

name: Water creature paramour
description: Certain woman or a group of women take for paramour a big water animal (caiman, otter, sea-lion, whale, anaconda; rare: water bird, crab), water spirit or monster. Husbands, brothers or (adoptive) children kill or maim paramour and/or (sometimes) the woman

name: Land animal paramour
description: Certain woman or a group of women takes for a paramour a big land animal. Husbands, brothers or (adoptive) children kill or maim paramour and (sometimes) the woman

name: Paramour mutilated
description: Person (usually a woman, rarely a man) has a monster or animal paramour or married woman has human lover. Legal marriage partner or close relative kills or maims paramour and serves his or her meat to the person (usually husband or brother serves paramour's penis to his wife or sister)

name: Sons kill paramour
description: The (adoptive) children or grandchildren and not person's spouse or brother kill the paramour of their (step)mother or father

name: Gourd vessel put on the surface of water
description: Person knocks the gourd vessel that floats above the water to call water monster or serpent. Usually a woman calls this way her monstrous paramour

name: Women and sacred knowledge
description: Women were possessors of the sacred knowledge, sanctuaries or ritual objects which are now taboo for them or they made attempts to acquire such a knowledge or objects

name: The epoch of women
description: The women dominated over the men in the past or in a far away land, were the active part in marriage relations, practiced activities which now are reserved of the men only

name: Husband of the first women
description: An anthropomorphic male or an androgyne is the only possessor or leader of women

name: A man in a village of women
description: A man gets into the village of women. Usually he has to satisfy every woman against his will or every woman claims him for herself

name: Patriarch kills the boys
description: A powerful man kills every baby boy born by his wives or by his sister

name: The men kill the women
description: The men of primeval community kill the women because of their unsocial behavior

name: The men abandon the women
description: The men feel themselves offended by the women and abandon them

name: Men turn into birds
description: Young men and boys turn into birds or bats, fly away

name: First women disappear
description: The women of the ancestral community kill or abandon the men

name: The women kill the men
description: The women of the ancestral community kill, try to kill or transform the men

name: Women disappear under the ground
description: When women of the ancestral community abandon the men, they disappear in the opening that leads underground

name: Bat-husbands
description: Marriage partners of the primeval women, the amazons or a solitary woman are small animals (usually flying foxes)

name: Women and men separate
description: The women and the men of the primeval community quarrel and abandon each other

name: The amazons
description: There are (or were) women who live apart from men in their own village or villages

name: Conception from wind
description: Before women got know how to conceive children from men, they exposed their genitals to the wind, sun and water; the women who live alone without men conceive children this way

name: One for all
description: The only existing or available woman is used sexually by many men (animal people)

name: Woman in a tree
description: Men (animal people) discover a woman in a tree and copulate with her there

name: Pieces of flesh turn to persons
description: The body of the of a living creature (woman or snake) is cut into pieces. Every man gets his piece, new women emerge from them

name: Men use pieces of woman’s flesh
description: Every man uses for copulation certain part of an only woman or takes a part of her body after it was cut into pieces

name: Why women are different
description: Different women are not similar physically because pieces of the first woman's flesh distributed between men were of unequal quality or because males who copulated with her had different nature

name: The abnormal birth
description: Cesarean operation upon a woman at childbirth as a custom

name: Animal explains how to give birth
description: A small animal (mouse, rat, rabbit, opossum, a bird) explains a woman how she can deliver her child in a natural way

name: The often-born children
description: Child or children come out of mother's womb and return back

name: Clandestine lover
description: Person who conceals his or her identity comes to his or her lover at night. Next time, the lover puts a mark on the stranger's face, body or clothes doing this intentionally (to recognize him or her) or by chance (that leads to the identification)

name: Aggressive sister
description: When incest relations with her brother come to light, the sister openly claims her brother for a husband, turns into monster, kills people

name: Following thread
description: To get know the nature or locality of a person, another fastens a thread to his body and follows it

name: Pubic hair for a bird’s crest
description: A bird person gets his crest putting on his head a pubic hair of a woman or part of her genitals

name: Ugly husband
description: An ugly man marries a girl but conceals his face. Marriage is ruined after his face is seen

name: Bat or owl hides his face
description: A man hides his face from his wife because she does not know that he is a nocturnal being (a bat or an owl)

name: Imperceptible scar (husband proves to be son)
description: After a rather long marriage, wife discovers some minor traits in her husband guise that help her understand that he is not a proper marriage partner but her close kin (brother or son) or a transformed animal

name: Traces of feathers
description: A youth or boy decorated with feathers and paint copulates incognito with his mother or sister. They discover his identity noticing on his body traces of feathers or paint

name: What do you want?
description: A woman cannot understand what does her partner want. She points at, names or suggests different things. At last she points at, names or exposes her genitals. This is the right answer

name: Watching vagina triggers incest
description: A man or boy thinks about incest when he gets to see his daughter(-in-law)'s, sister's, or mother(in-law)'s vagina

name: Shavings into the fire
description: To create opportunity to see female genitals, a man throws something combustible into the fire which makes the woman fall on her back and expose her vagina

name: Trickster and women
description: A man cohabits with a group of women (or with several women in succession) concealing his identity and/or intentions. He is either eventually exposed and punished by women or escapes to continue his tricks

name: Man to woman: modified body
description: To make believe that he is a female, a trickster transforms particular objects or creatures into female body parts or into a baby child

name: Trickster cures maiden
description: A girl gets sick. A man comes to cure her but only copulates with her or makes an attempt to do so

name: Trickster rapes a woman who carries him on her back
description: A man pretends to be weak, ill or injured, asks a woman to carry him on her back. When she agrees, he makes attempt to copulate with her

name: Incognito at the dancing party
description: An (ostensibly) sick person remains at home when other go to the dancing party. The person comes by himself or herself looking like a handsome man or beautiful girl. The man (woman) does not recognize him (her) and suggests to make love

name: Trickster poses as woman and marries man
description: A male person turns into woman and marries a man. He is either unmasked or abandons his "husband" by his own will

name: The lecherous parent
description: Person changes his or (rare) her guise to marry his or her close relative in descending or (rare) ascending line

name: Describes future husband
description: Going away or pretending to die, a person bids his or her relative to marry another person who resembles him (her) or has some special traits; or he describes a man who should be met as a dear guest; person comes himself unrecognized and is taken for one whom he had described

name: Incestuous woman
description: A woman pretends to be a stranger to have sexual relations with her (grand)son, daughter or brother

name: The false burial
description: To realize his or her secret desire (illicit sex, refusal to share food with relations), person pretends to die and is abandoned at a burial place

name: Death feigned to meet paramour
description: Person pretends to die. His or her wife or husband abandons him or her on a burial place. He or she marries his or her paramour

name: Death feigned to eat burial food
description: Man pretends to die because he does not want to share food with the others and eats it alone at his burial place

name: The feigned burial: boy exposes deceit
description: A man feigns death to marry his daughter or to eat burial food. One of the younger children recognizes the (adoptive) father or gets to see that the false dead is alive (escapes from the burial pyre, laughs, etc.)

name: The feigned burial: wife does not believe
description: A man feigns death and is abandoned at the burial place. His wife (mother, aunt) gets to know about the deceit and provokes the man to show that he is alive

name: The false house
description: Person’s father, grandson, brother, or sister pretends to be a stranger to commit incest (accordingly with the daughter, grandmother, sister, or brother), or a husband shams to be his wife’s brother because he wants to be taken by her as her blood relative. To realize his or her stratagem, the hero imperceptibly runs to another house where the object of his or her interest later comes and takes him or her for a stranger

name: Old woman pretends to be man
description: An old woman makes herself false penis and testicles, marries or attempts to marry her (step)daughter

name: Death feigned: woman dresses up as a man
description: A woman pretends to die or really dies. Her (former) paramour comes to her grave. She revives and goes with him. Not to be recognized, she dresses up as a man

name: Obscene invitation
description: A woman's husband or male relative asks her (grand)children to invite her to make love with him. The invitation is expressed in an allegoric form. She understands, comes to him

name: Potiphar's wife: false accusation of sexual abuse
description: Woman makes vain overtures to young man and/or falsely accuses him of sexual abuse. Her husband believes that the young man is guilty, kills or tries to kill him

name: Disordered clothes as evidence against innocent man
description: To accuse a man or boy of (sexual) abbuse, a woman tears her clothes, smears or scratches her body pretending to be attacked

name: Revenge of a rejected woman
description: A woman revenges on a man who rejected her love

name: The castrated youth becomes a man again
description: A young man falls victim of an intrigue and is mutilated (usually castrated). His members are restored by magic, he marries happily

name: A disgraced informer
description: A castrate or girl pretends to be a man or a cripple girl conceles her injury. Some person gets to know about it and plans to expose the deception. At the last moment the hero or heroine magically becomes a real man (gets back the lost members) and the informer is disgraced

name: A girl turns into a man
description: A girl poses as a man, her sex is magically transformed and the man is happily married

name: Daughter instead of son
description: An old man needs a son to accomplish a man’s work or service. (Only the youngest) daughter sets to do it (successfully passing her father’s test and) guised as a man

name: Susan and the old men (the innocent slandered maiden)
description: An innocent girl or young woman rejects a man who attempts to seduce her. The man accuses her of loose conduct, ultimately the truth comes to light

name: Imitated violence
description: A woman asks a man to tie her before copulation in such a way that a watcher would think she is raped

name: The illusory wound
description: Person mistakes a vulva or an anus for a wound; vulva is a unhealed wound on the body of the primeval women

name: Naked person shams dead
description: When a person sees a dangerous enemy, he or she shams dead taking his or her clothes off, or the enemy takes off them himself. The enemy believes that it is a corpse, lets it alone

name: A siren and a tapir
description: A hunter watches tapir who calls a water woman from the river or lake and copulates with her. Hunter does the same, becomes the woman's lover

name: Animals teach to make love

name: Penis bridge

description: Genitals exist by themselves as separate beings, they can be stuck to the human body, remove, etc.

name: Incest with mother-in-law
description: A man uses a trick to have opportunity to make love to his mother-in-law or woman uses a trick to make love to her son-in-law. Usually a man takes with him on a hunt not his wife but her mother

name: What owl cries about
description: To lure prohibited sexual partner into his or her hammock, person imitates or interpretes in a certain way voices of birds and animals

name: News precede man
description: Person commits something shameful, obscene. Presumably, nobody could see him doing it. When he asks people, "What's the news?", they answer that so-and-so (this person) has done such a thing

name: Indecent proposal made through children
description: Animal person comes to children of a big predator and tells them that he will copulate with their mother (or that he will beat her)

name: Prolonged celibacy imitated
description: Person has sex with the wife of his host or brother. Trying to conceal his deed, he puts ashes or juice of a fruit on his glans that has to prove his long celibacy

name: The Moon: contra men and pro women
description: The Moon (female or male) is the leader of women in their struggle against the men or leads the women away from the men

name: Signal for paramour to come out
description: Person summons with a certain signal his or her sexual partner or ward who is of non-human nature. Another person spies, uses the same signal or pronounces the same words, kills those who come to him or uses them sexually himself

name: An eaten up pet
description: Person take care for a fish, crab or other small creature. Another person spies on him or her, kills the pet and eats it up or try to do it

name: Transformed children of serpent’s wife
description: A girl marries snake, comes with her children to visit her relation. Her close kin (father, mother, brother) tries to get know from her children how their mother calls her husband. A girl tells the secret, mother (father, etc.) of the woman calls the snake with the same signal, kills him. Seeing  her husband dead, the woman transforms her children (and herself) into birds or trees

name: Odor of women
description: Initially women's genitals were fragrant or had no smell. Because of a bad chance they acquire unpleasant odor or do not acquire fragrant odor

name: A smart sister
description: Sister and brother live alone. The brother rejects the incest. The sister makes him take her for unknown girl, marries him

name: A tragic incest
description: Brother and sister marry each other. When their children get to know about the incest, they kill their parents, or father kills children, or parents suicide, or wife/sister suicides when her husband/brother has died

name: A worm-breeder
description: A man lets his wife to be eaten up by worms. She either dies or has a narrow escape

name: Homosexual play
description: A male person is tricked into being used sexually by another man

name: The talking penis
description: A man's member speaks and can be silenced only by his mother-in-law

name: Rival wives in the sky
description: A man gets to the sky where he has a choice to marry one of two women, one of them being connected with life and another with death

name: Wife of one of two brothers
description: Two companions or brothers live together. One has a wife which he conceals. Another suspects her existence, destroys her or tries to get a wife also for himself

name: Ugly man becomes handsome
description: A girl rejects an ugly youth, men also do not like him. A powerful supernatural makes him handsome while those who were evil to him are punished

name: The prohibited fruit: origin of sex
description: After eating certain fruit, berry, tuber, etc. people become sexually aware

name: God and a cow
description: Anthropomorphic god descends from the sky and copulates with a cow

name: A baby copulates with his mother
description: A baby son turns into an adult man, copulates with his mother, then acquires his baby guise

name: Test of chastity (a queen and a servant girl)
description: A magic medicine demonstrates that the only chaste woman is a servant girl, orphan, etc. King chooses the chaste one

name: A kidnapped child
description: Valuables (earth, soil, sun, crops, fire, sacred knowledge, hunting luck) are got or returned when son or daughter is stolen from his or her parent

name: A rock of crops
description: Cultivated plants or fertile soil to plant them are hidden inside a rock. Birds or Thunders get them destroying the rock

name: A food mountain
description: Cultivated plants are found above or inside a mountain

name: Food tree
description: Fruits and shoots of different cultivated plants grow on the branches of one tree or certain plant has a tree form that is alien to it in nature

name: Primeval tree
description: One of the trees is the principal, original one (emerged before all the other; ancestor of wild or cultivated plants; ocean or rivers inside it; world axis; higher than all the others; overshadows sky)

name: Blunt axes
description: Ancestors need to fell a gigantic tree or a vertical rock. Their axes become blunt or break and/or they are in search of a proper axe to cope with their work. Usually they are cutting the tree with different cultivated plants on its branches

name: Restored tree
description: A deep notch in the tree (or in the sky support) is magically restored as soon as persons or creatures who cut or gnaw it stop working

name: Cutting tree to make a canoe
description: To make some object (usually a canoe), person cuts a tree, goes away, returns, finds the tree intact. Usually another person who was restoring the tree by magic fells it down himself and makes a canoe for the hero

name: Cutting tree to get a person
description: Person hides in a tree. Somebody tries to fell it but the notch disappears and the tree becomes intact

name: Cutting tree to get valuables
description: (Animal-)people try to fell a tree that contains water and fish or has cultivated plants on its branches. The notch disappears and the tree becomes intact

name: Falling or growing up of a tree is dangerous to the world
description: To save the world (gods, king, etc.) certain persons or creatures try to cut or gnaw a tree (post, mountain) or do not permit the others to do. The notch disappears and the tree (post, etc.) becomes intact

name: Cutting the Moon tree
description: Person tries to cut down the tree in the Moon but the notch disappears and the tree becomes intact

name: Chips destroyed
description: A deep notch in the tree is magically restored when persons or creatures who cut it go away to take a rest. They get to fell the tree after they begin to burn the cut off chips or to carry them far way

name: Restored forest
description: People break ground or fell trees. In the morning, the ground or forest are intact again

name: Restored forest and flood
description: A man fells trees to clear ground for a garden. Certain person or animal revives vegetation and after being surprised by the man, warns him about the coming flood, tells to prepare a boat

name: The hanging tree
description: A tree which trunk is cut through do not fall because it is hold from above

name: Squirrel the woodcutter
description: A squirrel plays crucial role in felling the gigantic tree

name: Tree is a person
description: A giant tree (often with water inside it or with different cultivated plants on its branches) grows out of the human body or is transformed person

name: Plants from drops of blood
description: Cultivated plants emerge from drops of blood or spill from cuts on the body of a person

name: Star-person gives plants
description: Star-person is a giver of cultivated plants

name: Fox brings plants from the sky
description: Fox or coyote returns from the sky and disperses seeds or shoots unknown on earth before

name: People ate rotten wood
description: Before acquisition of cultivated plants people ate rotten or soft (Ceiba L., Ochroma Sw.) wood; some people eat rotten wood

name: People ate dirt
description: Before acquisition of cultivated plants people ate dirt, mud or stones

name: People ate fungi
description: Before acquisition of cultivated plants people ate fungi

name: Swallowed man returns with plants
description: A man is swallowed by a water monster and comes out from its belly in the land of the supernatural beings. He receives from them cultivated plants and brings them to people

name: Plant maidens
description: In the other world or in the time of the ancestors food products or materials used by people looked as persons

name: Ants find cultivated plants
description: Ants are the first who find cultivated plants (corn or manioc) which are concealed from the others in particular place

name: Gift of a reptile
description: Serpent or alligator is the original possessor or the source of cultivated plants or wild staples

name: Person wants to be killed
description: A boy, woman or (more rare) man asks other people to abandon him or her in the forest, to burn or drag her or him on or around the future garden plot, to burn her in her house, etc. A woman usually asks to kill her when she understands that people know her way of producing food which she extracts from her own body. People fulfill person's wish and find cultivated plants on the place

name: Burned men bring plants
description: After a conflict in primeval community, a group of men or youths (Paresi: a boy and a girl) burned themselves in a bonfire (or leap over it, etc.). As a result, people acquire cultivated plants, especially corn

name: Woman turns into plants
description: Food crops emerge from remains of a woman or girl

name: Coconut palm from a human head
description: Coconut palm grows out of the human head

name: Frog or toad and plants
description: Frog or toad is related to acquisition of cultivated plants

name: Alive being turns into many objects
description: Person or creature is transformed. Separate parts of its (his, her) body give origin to different objects or creatures

name: Alive being turns into plants
description: Person or creature is transformed. Separate parts of its (his, her) body give origin to different plants, mostly edible or cultivated

name: Alive being turns into nations
description: Different body parts of a huge being turn into people of different ethnic affiliation or such people receive their names and characteristics according to body parts that they got

name: Cereals spilled over the earth
description: Seeds of cereals have been spilled over the earth, now people cultivate them

name: Swallowed food: saved for people
description: Food products were swallowed or hidden in person's mouth. Thanks to this people got them

name: Plants from urine
description: Person urinates producing the first cultivated plants

name: The fish tree
description: Tree contains fish in its trunk

name: Demon made of artifacts
description: Demonic person turns into or consists of different household objects or tools (and into elements of a landscape)

name: Chopped penis turns into plants
description: A cut off long penis turns into many edible plants

name: Trees tied up with a rope
description: To clear a garden plot, persons put a rope around many trees, pull it, all the trees fall

name: The originator of death the first sufferer
description: One person wants man to live forever, another wants man to be mortal. When somebody dear to the latter one dies, he or she is eager to accept the suggestion of his or her opponent but the original decision cannot be changed

name: Death of a neighbor’s child
description: Person does something that results in originating of death because death of some alive being deer to another person is indifferent or desirable for him or her

name: The not revived dog
description: Person refuses to revive a dog which is dear to another person, and this conflict is related to the missed opportunity to revive people

name: Stamped down grave
description: People do not come back to life (or do not come anymore to their relatives after death) when somebody buries the dead in a grave or stamps down the earth on the grave

name: The selfish animal
description: Animals ask God to make people mortal because people would be too numerous and step on the animals, deprive them of their food and habitat, or because the animals want to feast on the human corpses

name: Sham funerals bring death
description: People become mortal because they imitated real funerals burying an animal

name: The shed skin
description: Those who change their skin become young again. In many cases, people are contrasted to snakes, invertebrates or some trees who shed their skin or bark and rejuvenate

name: Process of rejuvenation is broken
description: People do not become young (usually do not shed their skin) anymore because certain person was bothered during rejuvenation or was not recognized by his family in his new guise

name: People and snakes
description: Reptiles or invertebrates are contrasted with men as immortal with mortals and/or are responsible for originating of death; or a snake's bite inflicts the first death

name: People and plants
description: Mortal humans are contrasted with (almost) immortal trees that shed their bark, become green again after winter sleep or propagate by sprouts

name: The life-medicine spilled on plants
description: The life-medicine is accidentally spilled not on men but on plants which become evergreen, capable for regeneration or producing fruits

name: The lost objects
description: Animal person is sent to pass to the people certain objects or substance but loses or replaces them. Because of this people miss possibility to become immortal or their life becomes difficult

name: The immortal raven
description: Raven is contrasted with people as an immortal with mortals (usually is sent to bring water of immortality or drinks itself water of immortality)

name: Stolen immortality
description: Person brings a remedy that gets immortality. While he is asleep, somebody else steals the remedy

name: The personified Death
description: Death (alone or with Old Age, Disease, etc.) is a particular personage not identical with the Master of the Dead. Death comes and kills people

name: The Death and a doctor
description: Man receives from Death (Fortune, some spirit) knowledge will the patient recover or die. He becomes a doctor and receives rich rewards. Usually he gets the ability to see Death near the bed of a patient and considering a particular place where Death stands, gets to know perspectives of recovering

name: The Death in a tree
description: A man has a tree from which nobody can climb down without his will. He lures there Death or Devil who came after him

name: Not finished prayer
description: Death promises to take a man after he has finished a prayer. The man begins to pray but does not finish his prayer and the Death cannot take him

name: The failed test
description: People lose immortality because they do not dare to touch or drink something loathsome, poisonous, hot or otherwise dangerous

name: Strong and weak
description: People are mortal because they have been likened to something subject to decay and easy destruction (e.g. to the soft wood and not to the stone)

name: Who will give birth the first
description: One woman is associated with stone, another with a plant. The plant-woman gives birth the first or the stone-woman do not have children at all. That's because people have their present characteristics (are mortal, capable to speak, etc.), or offsprings of the two women are different (skillful and not, etc.)

name: Children as shoots of plants
description: People are likened to plants which are mortal but revive in their offsets

name: Stone sinks, stick floats
description: People are mortal because stone thrown into the water sank. They have missed a chance to be like wood or other organic matter that floated

name: The call of God
description: People become mortal because they do not hear or answer a call of a being who promises them immortality (or do not pronounce his name) or answer a call (pronouns the name) of a being who brings death

name: Orpheus: visit to the land of the dead
description: Alive person visits the land of the dead, usually following a dead person

name: Dead woman pursues her husband
description: Wife dies, husband comes after her or he kills his untrue wife. The dead wife turns into monster and pursues him

name: Ghosts feed on excrements
description: Inhabitants of the land of the dead eat excrements

name: Dead person returns and revives
description: Person comes to the land of the dead and brings back somebody who has recently died. This person becomes alive and lives normal life

name: Woman flies back to the land of the dead
description: A dead woman returns to earth but flies back as a bird or a fly

name: Whisper and yawning
description: If called in a loud voice, ghosts do not hear an alive person but hear whisper, yawning, etc.

name: Rivers of tears and blood
description: Rivers or lakes of tears, milk, blood, or water used for washing corpses exist in the world of the dead or separate it from our world

name: Ring of defenders around chief
description: Ancestors surround their (dead) chief trying to defend him or his corpse. A trickster gets to go through the ring, kills the chief or steals and devours his heart

name: Hoarded game released
description: Game animals were concentrated in one single place. Certain person lets them disperse in the world

name: Pup lets animals lose
description: The owner of game animals conceals them underground. One of the ancestors turns into pup, is adopted by owners' children, lets the animals lose

name: Cattle returns into water
description: Because of a broken taboo (to look, to speak in a loud voice, etc.) domestic animals are lost (disappear in water, remain in the sky, scatter in various directions, etc.)

name: Raven tries to starve people
description: Raven hides or scares game animals preventing hunters to kill them. People outwit him

name: Fish disperse in the world
description: All the fish or (rare) shellfish) was concentrated in one place. Certain person lets it lose or puts it into the rivers or sea

name: Mistress of fish loses it
description: A woman (a girl, several women) keeps all the fish for herself. Man comes and lets fish escape into rivers or sea.

name: Animals or fish kill a child
description: Person possesses game animals or fish. A boy or a girl knows this secret or is used as a luring device. Another person asks or forces the boy or girl to serve him the same way or the boy himself makes an attempt to hunt or fish. As a result, the boy or girl is killed or carried away by animals or fish

name: Not to kill the big fish
description: The owner of fish holds it in a container and regularly takes as much as he needs. Another person opens the container breaking the rules and the fish escapes

name: Sense of smell
description: Big game animals obtain sense of smell and/or become to escape from hunters after a person makes them olfactory organs or lets them feel strong odor

name: Animals disperse after being touched by people
description: Big game animals were concentrated in one place, had no fear of people. They escape and disperse after somebody slightly strikes or stains them

name: Fat horns
description: Objects that are now stiff and inedible  (animal horns, tree fungi, heartwood) contained fat or marrow

name: Container opened too early
description: Container with valuables or with dangerous creatures is opened (before time). Its content goes out of control or disappear

name: A bag with stars
description: Person opens a bag with stars which ascend to sky in disorder

name: Souls disappear from the opened container
description: Person receives a container with the soul of a dead person and has to open it not before he gets to particular place or after particular time interval. He opens it too early, the soul fly away

name: Death in container
description: People open container with death or disease inside and become mortal

name: Still picks up what was let lose
description: Animal person who let lose the content of a container entrusted to him or her (darkness, insects, reptiles, etc.) still tries to pick up what was let lose (etiology of behavior of certain animal species)

name: To choose life or death
description: People are suggested to choose one of two objects, associated with life and death. They choose the object with death

name: Meat in a package
description: Putting a lot of meat or fish in a small package, person gives it to another warning him not to open it on the way. The warning is ignored, meat or fish falls out and cannot be put back

name: To choose life or death
description: People are suggested to choose one of two objects, associated with life and death. They choose the object with death

name: Mosquitoes had to be drowned
description: The right way to dispose of container with stinging insects would be to throw it into the river or sea or bury in a far away place, but it was not done

name: Mosquitoes let lose
description: Stinging insects (rare diseases) had been inside a container or some enclosure. They escaped to the world when the container or enclosure was foolishly opened

name: A hole in the ground
description: During the creation of the earth Creator's antagonist demands for himself as much earth as would be enough to put his staff. He thrusts the stake into the ground (rare: pulls out a certain pole). Insects and reptiles come out of the opening and/or the antagonist falls down through it into the underworld

name: Plagues from the body of a person or creature
description: Killed and destroyed (often burned) person or creature (usually ogre, fierce animal, powerful shaman) turns into a multitude of biting insects or into other small molesting creatures

name: Mosquitoes from sparks and smoke
description: A burned person or creature immediately turns into a multitude of mosquitoes or biting flies

name: Origin of foreigners
description: A woman is impregnated by an animal, usually by a snake. People of hostile nation originate or receive their culture from her progeny or from her paramour's relatives

name: A wrong choice
description: Seeing two women who have come together or in succession, man has to choose one of them. Usually he takes the one who is less pretty and smart or more dangerous inflicting troubles on himself and humanity

name: Origin of death: man and celestial bodies
description: God summons to him man and celestial bodies and makes the man mortal and others immortal

name: Superfertility lost: a maltreated wife
description: Supernatural woman comes to live with humans. Thanks to that, food becomes easily available. She is maltreated, goes away, temporal superfertility is lost forever

name: Superfertility lost: a maltreated child
description: A small girl or boy who is a child of a deity comes to live with humans. Thanks to that, food or other resources become easily available. The child is maltreated, returns to its own world, human life becomes difficult and scanty

name: Walking babies
description: Children walked or could walk from the very birth but this ability was lost or never obtained

name: Babies thrown across a hedge
description: A woman did not allow God to throw her baby across a hedge, roof, etc. Because of this babies lost or never got ability to walk from the very birth

name: Controversy over conditions of life
description: Person has a series of suggestions how to make the world easy for living and free of hard work and death. His companion successively rejects them

name: Rivers flow in both directions
description: Rivers were flowing or according to the original plan had to flow in both directions; somewhere there is a river that flows in both directions

name: Flying rice
description: Rice could flow arriving by itself to the household

name: Edible sky in the past
description: Sky or sky objects were edible or used as medicine but since the sky had separate from the earth this source of food became inaccessible. Inhabitants of the distant land where the sky and the earth come together feed on pieces of the sky

name: The edible snow
description: Snow was edible or something edible was falling from the sky instead of the snow

name: Walking baskets
description: Baskets carried loads by themselves

name: One grain porridge
description: One cereal grain (cob, etc.) is enough to prepare a meal

name: Firewood come by themselves
description: Firewood, brushwood arrived to the house themselves, no work was needed to cut and carry them

name: Fragile teeth
description: Human teeth are made of material subject to easy damage (etiology of tooth ache in most cases)

name: The muddled message
description: Person is sent by god to bring instructions or certain objects but distorts, forgets or replaces them. This has fatal consequences for humans or for a certain species of animals

name: Origin of death from the falsified message
description: Person is sent by god to bring instructions or certain objects but distorts, forgets or replaces them. Because of this people become mortal (do not revive after death)

name: Death and the chameleon
description: Chameleon is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Death and the lizard
description: Lizard is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Death and the hare
description: Hare is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Death and the rat
description: Rat is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Raven is a failed messenger
description: Raven is sent to deliver important object or message. It distorts message, loses object

name: Death and the raven
description: Raven is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Muddled message: how many meals a day
description: God sends his messenger to tell people that they should eat only rarely (once in three days or the like). The messenger tells them that they should eat often (three times a day)

name: Death and the coyote
description: Coyote is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: The unhappy jump
description: Some beings, frog and toad among them, have to overcome an obstacle. This is realized not the way it was planned and as a consequence, people become mortal

name: Death and the frog
description: Frog or toad is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Death and the lark
description: Lark is responsible for introduction of permanent death

name: Magic device lost by a failure
description: Magic object, device that makes hunting or fishing easy gets into possession of a person who is unable to operate it or abuses it. The device kills or injures the failure himself, other people and/or disappears

name: Jump over brushwood kindles fire
description: Person gives a trickster ability to kindle fire easily. He uses it without need, it is lost

name: Charge of skunk used to no purpose
description: Person gives a trickster his power (usually skunk gives his charge) but he squanders it all to see the effect. When a real need comes, the device does not work anymore

name: Supernatural person comes after his property
description: Supernatural person changes his guise and comes to the hero's children (more rare, to him). They hand him what he asks for and he disappears with his former property is

name: The spilled poison
description: Snakes drink liquid spilled on earth and become poisonous or immortal; creatures obtain their characteristics (usually becomes poisonous) after drinking or licking a particular medicine

name: Dog is the guard of man
description: Dog guards (successfully or unsuccessfully) the (still unfinished) physical body of man

name: Death and the dog
description: Dog is responsible for people being mortal or imperfect. Usually the antagonist bribes dog with a warm fur and the dog lets him spoil the half-ready human figures

name: Creator goes away for a while
description: After creating the bodies of the first people or after getting a conception how to do it the Creator goes away for a while. During his absence another person, because of his or her ignorance or intentionally, spoils the creation or makes himself or herself what the Creator would make in a better way. Usually because of this people are mortal and subject to diseases

name: One creates the body, another the soul
description: One supernatural creates the body of the first people, another revives them

name: Broken figure of the first man
description: After making human body, creator goes away for a time. In his absence another person makes attempt to break human figure that was not yet alive

name: Figure of the first man smeared with filth
description: After making human body, creator goes away for a time. In his absence another person spits on the human figure that was not yet alive, smears it with filth, etc.

name: Sky and Earth divide their children
description: Two persons, one of whom is connected with the sky or the water and another with the earth, divide their child or people created by them. Sky or Water takes the imperishable part, and Earth, the perishable

name: The abused bread
description: A woman or child demonstrate no respect for bread soiling it with excrements. For this God punishes all the humanity

name: The dog’s part
description: To punish people, God deprives them of bread but keeps a small part for a dog or other domestic animal. That’s because cereals still exist

name: Offended sky or earth
description: The sky (or the earth) is offended by people’s behavior in respect to it and reacts accordingly (e.g. rises higher than it was before)

name: Daughters of evil spirit
description: Diseases are sisters (rare: brothers), usually children of evil spirit

name: Pet defends master’s child
description: A dog or other animal or bird kills dangerous creature who was going to attack the pet's master or his child. The master thinks that the assailant was the pet, kills it, then regrets his deed

name: Sky god and mistress of the dead
description: A couple of deities or ancestors divorces. Man remains on earth or ascends to the sky, woman becomes the mistress of the dead or of the underworld

name: The demonic horse
description: A horse is associated with antagonist of the God

name: The search of immortality
description: Person sets off in search of the country where there is no death. He finds it. He decides to visit his home and dies there

name: Wolf is the master of the dead
description: Wolf takes part in creation and/or is a brother of the creator who wins demons of the lower world. Wolf is the first person who died and/or becomes the master of the dead

name: The eyelids of Viy
description: Eyelids or eyebrows of personage hang long down over his eyes. To make him see, eyelids should be propped up with poles, folks, etc.

name: Sinners in other world
description: Person who visits the other world gets to see different people punished or rewarded according to their behavior when they were alive on earth

name: A married couple under one blanket
description: Person gets to see husband and wife who pull their blanket from each other or have not enough space for two on their bed

name: The prohibited fruit (origin of death)
description: After eating certain fruit, berry, tuber, etc. people become mortal (cf. motif F97: people become sexually aware)

name: The thunderbirds
description: Creatures that produce rain and/or thunderstorms are birds or anthropomorphic beings with wings; or (rare) some or all birds are connected with thunder, lightning or rain though Thunder is not a bird

name: Lightning from eyes
description: Lightning emerges from eyes or mouth of the being who is thought to produce thunderstorms

name: Weapons of Thunder
description: The lightning (and thunder) is (produced with) an object (axe, sword, mirror, belt, stones, skin, etc.) in hands of anthropomorphic being

name: Thunder in trouble: falls to earth
description: Thunder falls to earth, cannot return to the sky. Usually a human person helps him to do it

name: Thunder in trouble: fights with his enemy
description: A man helps Thunder who fights with his enemy

name: The imprisoned Thunder
description: Thunder-god is temporarily overcome and imprisoned by his ebemy

name: Thunder’s instrument stolen
description: Thunder’s instrument is stolen from him. He or his helper comes unrecognized to the thief, gets his instrument and kills the enemies

name: Thunder is an animal
description: Thunder looks like a quadruped mammal (pig, buffalo, camel, anteater, tapir, dog, cat, leopard, monkey, etc.)

name: Thunderous tapir
description: Tapir is associated with the upper world, usually with the thunder

name: Weather birds
description: A man gets to the nest of giant birds. When the birds come, they bring with them clouds, rain, hail, etc. Usually, nestlings tell the man what kind of weather their father or mother brings

name: Male and female birds: different kinds of precipitation
description: The male and the female birds bring with them different kinds of precipitations (e.g. the male comes with a hail, the female with a rain)

name: The cloud serpent
description: A flying reptile produces rain, thunderstorm

name: The lightning- serpent
description: The lightning is associated with a snake

name: The suspended earth
description: The earth does not fall down or swing because it is suspended to ropes

name: Four supports of the world
description: The sky or the earth rests upon four or five (cardinal points and the center) supports of any kind (poles, mountains, giants)

name: One support of the world
description: Only one pole or mountain supports the earth or the sky

name: Atlas
description: One giant supports the earth or the sky

name: A man and a woman hold the earth
description: Two anthropomorphic beings, a male and a female, are in the underworld and support the earth

name: Original earth unstable
description: Originally the earth was unstable and swung, then it was fixed up

name: Colors of the cardinal directions
description: Four cardinal directions and/or some objects associated with them are associated with different colors

name: Colored layers of the sky
description: Different sky levels or different categories of clouds have different colors

name: Colored layers of the earth
description: Particular layers or categories of the earth have different colors

name: Cosmic turtle or toad
description: A turtle, toad, or frog supports the earth or is its embodiment

name: The world axis
description: A tree or post pierces and unites different layers of the universe

name: The horned serpent
description: Giant water-chthonic or sky serpent or dragon has horns or antlers on its head

name: A horned snake
description: Snake of natural size has horns on its head

name: Snake’s crown
description: Reptiles possess treasure with magic properties. Person gets or tries to get it. Usually it is a crown, jewel or small horns on the snake's head

name: No-anus people
description: Person or creature has no anus opening

name: Eject digested food through the mouth
description: No-anus people eject digested food through the mouth or other orifice

name: No-mouth people
description: Anthropomorphic beings have no mouths

name: A vertical cut
description: Mouth of human being was first cut vertically

name: Body anomalies of the first people
description: First human beings have no mouth, anus or genitals, their women do not know how to give birth

name: Body anomalies of inhabitants of a distant land
description: A race of anthropomorphic beings without mouth, anus, genitals, whose women do not know how to give birth lives in the underworld, in the sky, in a far-away land

name: A spouse or husband without anus or mouth
description: Person visits people who have no anus or mouth. He or his sister marries or tries to marry a local dweller

name: People inhale the odor of food
description: Anthropomorphic beings satisfy their hunger cooking food and inhaling the odor

name: The underworld dworfs
description: Race of dwarfs lives in the underworld

name: The sky giants
description: Anthropomorphic inhabitants of the upper world are giants

name: Belt on armpits
description: People in the upper world are different than on earth and put their belts not on the waist but higher or below it

name: Red-haired people scorched by the sun
description: People who live in the underworld, at the sunrise or sunset (often dwarfs) are scorched by the Sun which moves by at a short distance from them. They are red-haired, dark-skinned, etc.

name: Symplegades (obstacle opens and closes)
description: Souls on their way to the land of the dead, heroes or shamans have to go between moving rocks, trees, river banks, etc. which are incessantly meeting and parting

name: Rising and falling sky
description: The sky is constantly moving up and down in respect to earth

name: Birds fly to the outer world
description: Migratory birds fly from our world to the outer world under the edge of the sky which is rising and falling or through a narrow opening. Many birds perish. Eventual details: person who lives at this place feeds on these birds; it can be mistress of birds lives on another side of the pulsating obstacle

name: Snapping door
description: The door of a house is opening and closing by itself crashing persons who attempt to come in or out

name: A snake bridge
description: Snake, lizard or worm is a bridge or a rope over the river

name: The bribed guards
description: Way to the place of a certain person is guided by dangerous creatures (which often stand on the both sides of the pathway). Person placates them by gifts or nice talk, and they let him or her go the both ways, sometimes being punished for this by their master

name: Bones to cows
description: Person sees that food put for certain animals is inedible for them and corrects situation (usually gives to herbivorous animals food that was given before to predators and vice versa)

name: Dangers on the way of souls
description: On its way to the Beyond, a soul has to defend itself or divert attention of guards who wait for it giving presents to them

name: Chthonic canine
description: A dog is the lord, guard or guide of/to the land of the dead; or dogs live on the way to the land of the dead

name: Towns and paths of dogs
description: Souls of the dead dogs have their own towns in the Beyond or their own paths to travel there

name: Dog as a ferryman
description: A dog ferries person across a river that forms a border between the worlds

name: The four-eyed dog
description: Dogs having spots over the eyes are called the four-eyed and believed to have special properties (e.g. to see ghosts)

name: Animals in the underworld
description: Game animals live inside a mountain, in a cave or in the underworld where they often look like humans and have a master

name: Animals produce earthquakes
description: Big game animals disappear under the earth and produce earthquakes

name: Armadillo’s hole leads to the underworld
description: Person crawls after an armadillo into its hole and gets into the underworld or digs a hole and gets into the world of the armadillos

name: Master of the dead welcomes women
description: Master or mistress of the realm of the dead copulates with every new human soul of the opposite sex who arrives to his or her realm

name: Master and mistress of the dead
description: In the Beyond, every soul is treated by the mythological characters of the opposite sex

name: Tree of the babies
description: There is (or was) a tree on which souls of still unborn babies grow, which leaves transform into people, or which trunk is covered with female breasts or flowers that innumerable babies are sucking

name: Tree of human life
description: When a leave or a fruit of a certain tree drops, one of the people on the earth dies

name: Tree of the dead
description: The ultimate aim of the afterlife journey is to reach certain tree

name: The dangerous tree
description: It is necessary to approach a tree which is surrounded with fire, ejects fire, shoots sharp splints, etc.

name: Dragging a hide produces thunder
description: Thunder is produced by dragging behind a dry animal skin or (rare) a person (rare) or by shaking clothes

name: Old woman’s thunder
description: Thunder is produced by an old woman who lives in the sky

name: Challenge to Thunder-god
description: Person pretends to be the sky-god imitating rain and thunderstorm

name: Thunder and lightning are two siblings
description: Two siblings turn into thunder and lightning or into two thunders or one turns into thunder, another into an animal

name: Mushrooms are excrements
description: Mushrooms are excrements of mythological person

name: Fungi are steps, platforms, obstacles
description: Tree fungi are steps, small platforms, umbrellas, obstacles that make moving easier or more difficult, provide a shelter or cover

name: Fungi are ears
description: Fungi or mushrooms are named “ears”

name: Fungi shout
description: Tree fungi shout like persons

name: The dog-heads
description: Some beings are half-men and half-dogs (usually anthropomorphic with heads of dogs)

name: The dog-husbands
description: Dogs or dog-headed men are husbands of human women

name: Rainbow road or bridge
description: Rainbow is a road or bridge by which some ascend to the sky or descend from it

name: Rainbow bow
description: Rainbow is a bow

name: Rainbow serpent
description: Rainbow is a reptile (usually a snake) or (more rare) a fish, or it is related to snake, to its tongue, breath, or to scorpion's tail

name: Rainbow from an anthill
description: Rainbow rises from an anthill

name: Rainbow is a pair of creatures
description: Rainbow is two creatures or persons, usually a male and a female

name: The celestial monster
description: Giant reptilian monster (serpent, more rare fish, chain of fish) extends in the sky and/or supports the sky being associated with Milky Way or the rainbow

name: Milky Way is a serpent or fish
description: Milky Way is a reptile, fish, or chain of fish

name: Chthonic serpent
description: Giant serpent lies on the perimeter of the earth or supports the earth

name: Not to point at the Moon or a star
description: Person who points at the Moon or a star or looks intently at them will get sick or die or his pointing finger will rot or wither

name: Not to point at the rainbow
description: It to point at the rainbow, pointing finger or entire arm will rot, wither or become crooked

name: Not to count stars
description: Person who counts stars will suffer diseases and misfortunes

name: Rainbow belt
description: Rainbow is the ornamented part of the clothes, its decoration, a belt

name: Old woman’s rainbow
description: Rainbow is associated with an old woman

name: Rainbow predicts future harvest
description: Intensity of particular colors of rainbow predicts good or bad harvest of particular crops

name: Rainbow rope
description: Rainbow is a rope to which a domestic animal is tied

name: Rainbow snare
description: Rainbow is a snare, a noose

name: Rainbow is filth
description: Rainbow is a flatulence of a demon, a spray of a skunk, is associated with spit, urine, feces, genitals, etc., causes skin diseases

name: Rainbow is fox’s wedding
description: Rainbow is associated with a wedding of foxes or jackals

name: Confined to the underworld
description: Certain person loses his or her freedom, is confined to a far away place (often, to the underworld) and acquires cosmic dimensions: supports the earth or the sky and/or his or her movements produce earthquakes or (rare) storms

name: The running earthquake
description: Earthquake is a person. Whenever he or she runs or walks, the earth trembles

name: Animal with more than four legs
description: An animal (a horse, an elk, a moose, a bear) with six, eight or ten legs is described or represented in art

name: Torn off legs
description: A demon tears off or devours one by one legs of a riding animal of the hero

name: Bull the earth-holder
description: Big mammal supports the earth

name: The earth is an animal
description: The earth or the sky are identified with a big quadruped mammal or are made of parts of its body

name: Fish the earth-holder
description: World is supported by fish or fish-like monster or the earth itself is such a monster

name: Insect bothers the world-supporting being
description: The animal or the fish which supports the earth is bothered by an insect. The animal moves and the earth trembles.

name: Water creature full of fish
description: Anaconda or a water monster has live fish or animals inside; is father of the fish; all fish emerge from its body

name: Stars are openings
description: Stars are openings in the firmament; holes in dwelling's covering are thought to be stars

name: Ghosts do not see people from earth
description: Person who gets into another world is invisible for its inhabitants and his touch makes local person ill

name: Thunder pursues his enemy
description: Thunder's enemies are evil spirits, reptiles, animals living in burrows. They hide from him in different objects, Thunder destroys these objects

name: Milky Way is the way of birds
description: Milky Way is the path of migratory birds (especially wild geese)

name: Milky Way is spilled straw
description: Milky Way is a trace of people who spilled on their way something related to agriculture (straw, chaff, hay, more rare flour, peas)

name: Milky Way is a seam in the sky
description: Milky Way is a sky seam, a concealed fissure or crack between two half of the sky vault

name: Milky Way is a stripe on belly
description: Milky Way is a longitudinal streak, associated with a white line, stripe along the middle of a belly of an animal

name: Milk on the Milky Way
description: Milky Way is a trace of spilled milk

name: Milky Way is a river
description: Milky Way is a sky river, water body, chain of beings that swim

name: Milky Way is a path of tapir
description: Milky Way is a path of tapir, or tapir is seen in the Milky Way

name: Race along Milky Way
description: Milky Way is a trace of two (rare: more) animals that were running a race

name: Milky Way of the dead
description: Milky Way is the path over which souls travel to the beyond or a path of the funeral procession

name: Ashes on Milky Way
description: Milky Way is ashes or smoldering coals

name: Rhea and Milky Way
description: Milky Way is a giant rhea

name: Opening of the sky
description: On a certain day, the sky vault opens and the interior of the sky is seen; usually any wish expressed at this moment will be fulfilled

name: Star dung
description: Shining sky objects or atmospheric phenomena are excrements of sky dwellers

name: Water reptile on plants on its back
description: Trees or reeds grow on the back of a monstrous reptile

name: Stars are plants
description: Stars are plants or roots of the plants which grow in the upper world

name: Stars are people
description: Stars are people, ghosts, anthropomorphic beings (interpretations of unique star objects like Venus or Polaris as persons not considered)

name: Stars are sparks
description: Stars (rare: suns and moons) are sparks or burning coals

name: Stars are stones
description: Stars are shining stones, spangles

name: Stars are fire-flies
description: Stars are fire-flies, glow-worms

name: World ages
description: Before present world, several (three or more) other worlds or races of people existed

name: Snake turns into dragon
description: After certain time a snake or fish turn into a dragon

name: Mouse turns into bat
description: After certain time a mouse turns into a bat

name: The lame thunder
description: Powerful person connected with thunder and rain is lame (usually after falling down from the sky)

name: The square earth
description: The earth is square, the sky is usually round

name: Thunder’s apprentice
description: Person gets to the house of Thunder, becomes his servant and breaking certain taboo or instructions, produces extensive thunderstorm or rain

name: The youngest Thunder
description: Man meets Thunders and becomes one of them

name: Waters rush down into the underworld
description: Waters of all rivers on earth run to the precipice where they rush down into the underworld

name: The chthonic crab
description: A giant crab produces earthquakes or floods, stops or can stop flow of the waters into the chasm

name: Haribda (the origin of tides)
description: It is tide when a creature belches out the sea water or ousts it with its body and it is ebb when it swallows the water or lets it go back

name: Venus is male
description: Morning and/or Evening Star is a male personage

name: Venus is female
description: Morning and/or Evening Star is a female personage

name: Venus is the Moon’s wife
description: Venus or some other bright star seen near the eastern or western horizon is female and wife of the Moon

name: Morning and Evening stars are a man and a woman
description: Morning and Evening stars are opposed as a man and a woman or vice versa

name: Star who sold her mother
description: It is told about Venus or other star that she sold her mother or father to have a beautiful attire

name: The sky of vultures
description: Birds, first of all vultures and eagles, live in the sky, usually at one or more layers of the upper world

name: Milky Way is a snow-shoes track
description: Milky Way is a path of a person who was walking on snow-shoes

name: Son of God frozen to death
description: In winter time despite warning son of the sky deity sets off (usually on his snow-shoes) and is frozen to death

name: Polaris is a pole, a nail
description: Polaris is a (tethering) pole or a nail

name: Horses around Polaris
description: Hoofed animals are walking around Polaris

name: Polaris is a man
description: Polaris is a man

name: Vessels with weather
description: Person gets to the sky and finds there several vessels with different kinds of weather, precipitations, times of the year and the like

name: Hairs into animals, scales into fish
description: Master of living beings sends down, hairs, scales, etc. which turn into birds, animals, fish

name: Down turns into snow
description: Snow is created from bird's down when certain bird in the sky shakes itself or certain person shakes his or her clothes made of bird down

name: Skull as a cave
description: Personages use a shelter which proves to be an object related to the world of the giants (a skull, a shoulder-blade, a mitten)

name: Series of creatures ever greater in size
description: Personage of gigantic dimensions in respect to normal humans and animals proves to be tiny dwarf in respect to another personage

name: Small or big? A dialogue
description: Two persons engaged into dialogue describe a series of objects and creatures as simultaneously giant and small

name: What is Two?
description: Antagonist names numbers from one to seven or nine, every time asking what it is. The hero gives answers that the antagonist accepts as correct ones.

name: The long bull
description: A bull or a horse of a huge length is described (the head in one field, the tail in another; person who is near the head walks a long time till he meets a one neat the tail)

name: Only child was able to pick it up
description: Strong men or a lot of people cannot move the corpse of a killed person or creature but a child or a woman does it easily

name: Boaster in search of a rival
description: Person boasts how strong he is. His wife tells him that he is not the only strong man. He sets off, meets a person who is much stronger than him

name: The hut in a mitten
description: Animals use for a shelter an object like a mitten, skull, etc. that belongs to the world of the people

name: Animal with many tails
description: There is a zoomorphic being with many tails

name: The lost caravan
description: At night travelers mistake some bright star for Morning Star, set off, take a wrong direction, perish or get into trouble

name: Water body a the base of a tree
description: There is a source or body of water at the base of a tree which connects layers of the universe and/or has gigantic dimensions and considered to be the main tree of the world

name: Rainbow transforms sex
description: Person who gets to walk under, over or through the rainbow changes his or her sex

name: Milky Way is the backbone
description: Milky Way is the backbone of the sky or of all the world

name: The Pleiades are openings
description: The Pleiades are holes in the firmament

name: The Pleiades are a sieve for grain
description: The Pleiades are a sieve to process agricultural products

name: Orion is a balance
description: Orion is a balance, scales

name: Orion is a shoulder-yoke
description: Orion is a shoulder-yoke

name: Orion is a staff
description: Orion is a staff, a crook

name: Bloody rainbow
description: Rainbow is blood, associated with war and death

name: The Pleiades are a hen with its chickens
description: The Pleiades are a brooding hen, hen with its chickens, chickens

name: The Pleiades are a duck’s nest
description: The Pleiades are wild ducks, a nest or eggs of a wild duck

name: The Pleiades are boys or men
description: The Pleiades are a group of boys or men, or a group of different people but predominantly males

name: The Pleiades are girls
description: The Pleiades are a group of girls or women (with children)

name: The Pleiades are mother with children
description: The Pleiades are a woman with her children

name: The Pleiades are a group of people
description: The Pleiades are any people (of any ages and sex, combined data of i99-i100a)

name: The Pleiades and a cuckoo
description: God transformed man into a cuckoo, his wife and children into the Pleiades

name: Stars and kids
description: The Pleiades or stars in general are associated with kids or lambs

name: Big Dipper is poles, a nailed skin
description: Several bright stars of Big Dipper or other constellation are poles which support or stretch an object like skin, shelter, etc.

name: Milky Way is a tree
description: Milky Way is a tree or a trace of a tree

name: The dog star
description: Sirius is associated with a dog or a wolf

name: Stars are moon’s fragments
description: Stars are fragments of broken Moon or (rare) Sun; or stars, the sun and the moon are formed from one and the same primeval person or creature

name: The celestial hand
description: One of constellations represents a hand with fingers

name: Ursa major is a person
description: Ursa major is only one anthropomorphic being, not several persons

name: Stars are nails
description: Stars are nails in the firmament or pegs, or stars are nailed to the sky

name: The Pleiades are a person
description: The Pleiades are only one anthropomorphic being, not several persons

name: Milky Way is the path of the Sun
description: Milky Way is the path of the Sun and/or Moon

name: The star plough
description: Orion (rare: other constellation) is a plough

name: Orion is mowers
description: (Belt of) Orion is (three) mowers or agricultural tools related to mowing and harvesting

name: The earth is a reptile
description: The earth is the body of a crocodile or a dragon

name: The monster boat
description: A boat is a fish, a living creature with a mouth, it can swallow people

name: Pig with the golden bristle
description: A pig made of gold or having golden bristles is a treasure

name: Ursa major and the Pleiades as men and women
description: Described in one and the same tale, Ursa major is associated with men and the Pleiades with women

name: Orion and the Pleiades as a man and a woman
description: Orion and the Pleiades are opposed as a man or men and a woman or women. Orion is usually male

name: Milky Way is the border between the seasons
description: The Milky Way is the border-line between seasons of the year or parts of the universe (the wet and the dry seasons, the sky and the earth, etc.)

name: Spider ferries from one world to another
description: Spider person raises the hero to the sky, helps him or her to return back to earth or otherwise helps to overcome the borderlines between worlds

name: Helpful spider-woman
description: Spider-woman (rare: spider-man) is a patron of the hero who lives in her house and marries her daughter

name: The dead shake the earth
description: The earthquakes are produced by the dead who are in the underworld or during the earthquakes the inhabitants of the lower world try to come out

name: Cornucopia
description: Food and clothes are extracted from the horn of a cow or goat

name: Ursa major and Ursa minor as twin constellations
description: Constellations of Ursa major and Ursa minor are interpreted as twin objects of the same type (two animals, two carts, etc.)

name: The Pleiades are insects
description: The Pleiades are a nest, a congestion of insects

name: Altair is the Sun’s messenger
description: Altair or Vega with a weak nearby star are believed to appear on the sky immediately after winter solstice though really it is not so

name: Ursa major is a boat
description: Ursa major is a boat

name: The Hiades are a jaw-bone
description: The Hyades are a jaw bone or a head of a big animal or anthropomorphic creature

name: Ursa major is a stretcher or grave
description: Ursa major is funeral stretcher or a grave

name: Ursa major is a bed
description: Ursa major is a bed, a bedstead

name: Ursa major is a dipper
description: Ursa major is a dipper, a ladle

name: Constellation of Heron
description: When constellation of Heron appears on the sky, the rain season begins

name: The sky net
description: Orion, the Pleiades, Ursa Major or Ursa Minor is a hunting or fishing net

name: The thread of life
description: Life of every man is related to certain thread. When the thread is cut, the man dies

name: Climbing a deer antlers up to the sky
description: A giant deer’s or deer-like creature’s antlers reach the upper world, a person climbs them to get there

name: The tree-husband
description: A girl marries a man or is impregnated by man who is or was incarnated in a tree

name: Impregnated from under the earth
description: A woman gives birth to a boy or twin boys after being impregnated without her knowledge when one of the animal persons crawls under the earth to the place where she sits on a ground

name: Death of the father
description: Heroes avenge their (grand)father's or uncles' death, not the death of their mother or both parents

name: Brothers as victims
description: Two or several brothers or friends are killed by antagonists. One of them is the father of the young hero who avenges their death or all of them are his uncles

name: The changed signs
description: A woman or a girl is in search of her husband, fiancé or kinsmen. She loses her way because certain person changed signs at the crossroad

name: Feathers at the crossroad
description: A woman or a girl is in search of her husband or other person. Bird feathers at the cross-road or near the person's dwelling mark the correct or the wrong way

name: Unborn children talk from the womb
description: A woman is in search of her husband or other person or object. Her unborn children speak from her stomach and shows her the correct way

name: Insect’s bite
description: A woman loses her way after being bitter by insect (wasp, bee, ant). She accuses her unborn sons of being the cause of the bite and/or slaps herself on her abdomen to punish the sons or to kill the insect. As a consequence her sons are offended and do not show her the correct way anymore

name: Unborn child asks to pick up some flowers
description: A quarrel between a mother and her sons in her womb flares up after they ask her to pick up flowers or fruits (usually the insect bites her when she picks flowers up)

name: Travelling girl comes across suitors
description: A girl (or two sisters) travel, usually in search of a proper marriage partner who lives far away or who has gone away. On her way or after reaching the place of destination the girl gets to some unpleasant suitors

name: Penis in a pot
description: A girl or two sisters get to old woman who suggests them to marry her son. It is a worm or alive penis preserved by its mother in a pot. The girl (the sister) rejects it, runs away

name: Honey-suitor
description: A suitor or husband is a fragrant Honey person or skillful honey-gatherer

name: Meeting at a feast
description: A girl gets to see her bridegroom for the first time at a feast and then sets off to his place following instructions received from him

name: Imposter kills his rival
description: After a girl marries a valuable suitor, a rejected imposter or his relations kill him

name: Imposter is a buffoon
description: In village where valuable marriage-partner lives an imposter plays the role of a buffoon

name: A valuable partner and an imposter live in one house
description: A valuable partner whom a girl (two sisters) should marry and an imposter live together in one and the same house

name: A hypocritical murderer
description: A murderer of a valuable marriage-partner pretends to mourn over him. His trick is exposed, people chase him

name: Woman turns into duck
description: A girl or two sisters marry a valuable partner. His rival kills or attempts to kill him or his wives. As a consequence, the women turn into water birds

name: Two sisters
description: Two sisters (if more, only two play a significant role in the plot) travel and meet an unpleasant suitor or get to an ogre

name: A flute-player
description: A girl or two sisters walk in search of the man whose beautiful voice or whose flute-play they listen

name: Woman gets to dangerous creatures
description: Walking in search of her husband, boyfriend, kinsmen, shelter woman or girl gets to the house of dangerous creatures where she is injured or killed

name: Woman gets to jaguars
description: Setting off (usually in search of her husband, boyfriend or kinsmen), woman gets to the place of dangerous felines

name: Woman gets to a toad
description: Setting off (usually in search of her husband, boyfriend or kinsmen), woman gets to the place of female toad or frog

name: Rejects to eat insects
description: Person perishes because being forced to clean ogre's or animal’s head infected with insects, refuses to bite the insects, spits in disgust or is suspected to do it

name: Frogs in hair
description: Instead of lice, there are other (bigger or dangerous) creatures in the hair of some persons or he or she pretends that his or her hair is infested with them

name: Woman falls from the sky
description: A woman who is pregnant or has a small child falls from the sky. She or a daughter born by her dies but her (grand)son is grown up

name: Mother is eaten up, children escape
description: An ogress devours a woman, gets into her house. Her daughters (daughter and son, one daughter) run away, climb a tree or a rope that hangs from the sky. Ogress pursues them and perishes

name: Wicked guest murders woman
description: When husband o brother leaves home to hunt, an evil spirit comes to his wife or sister. The spirit kills her or carries her away after injuring or transforming her

name: To serve food on the abdomen
description: A guest demands that a woman would serve him food on her abdomen

name: Belly burned through
description: An evil spirit kills a woman burning her belly through

name: Wicked guest: woman breaks taboo
description: When husband o brother leaves home to hunt, an evil spirit comes to his wife or sister and kills or injures her being able to do it because she has broken taboo to open the door, to look at the guest or to answer him or her

name: Two men from one
description: Two men or a man and a woman appear from two halves of the cut in two anthropomorphic body or embryo; or another man appears from part of the body of the first one or from his body discharge

name: Two women from one
description: A woman is torn or cut in half, two new women appear

name: The double woman
description: A demonic creature has a form of two women half merged like Siamese twins

name: Two animals from one cut in two
