description: Two halves of one animal cut in two turn into two new animals or into foreigners

name: Placenta person
description: A second person evolves from the placenta of the first one

name: A late son kills monsters
description: People disappear one by one. A lonely woman has a baby or finds a baby or she becomes pregnant magically and gives birth to a boy or twins. The boy grows up, exterminates the antagonists, usually revives and releases those who had disappeared

name: A mucus-boy
description: A woman is crying, mucus from her nose turns into a boy who grows up, overcome powerful adversaries

name: Grounded to powder
description: Hero is grounded to powder but resuscitates

name: Babies escape and return
description: Heroes (one, two, one of the two), usually beings still babies or embryos, escape into the water, are carried away into the wilderness or thrown into the water. They are caught (often with difficulty) by some persons or come to them by their own will

name: Son of grave
description: Mother dies or is killed. Her (still unborn) baby-son is buried with her. He comes out of the grace, meets people, then returns to the grave but ultimately agrees to remain with the people

name: Babies come out of the water
description: Baby heroes or embryos are found in a river or lake or come to people out of the water

name: Lodge-boy and Thrown-away
description: One of two small boys (or one of two pairs of boys, two of three boys) lives in a lodge with his (adoptive) father or mother. The young male who lives in the lodge can be also a pup (allegedly) born by the woman. Another boy (or couple of boys) has been thrown away or born by his mother after her death, grows up by himself or is grown up by some spirit, comes to his brother(s) and ultimately to his (adoptive) parent. Usually (adoptive) father or mother catches him and domesticates with much difficulty

name: Thrown-away kills his father
description: One of two babies is thrown away and lives in the water, in the forest, etc., another lives in the house; after both of them become to live in the house, they kills their father

name: Truth about father
description: Hero asks how one of his parents died and receives a series of false answers. Usually he successively exposes himself to the same dangers, survives and thus demonstrates that truth is still concealed from him

name: A hot scone
description: A youth gets to know that a woman (usually his mother) conceals from him important information about his father, brothers or bride. He causes her pain (usually putting hot scone, handful of hot grain, etc. into her hand) making her tell him the truth

name: Father’s shadow
description: A murdered parent of the hero comes to him as a ghost and informs about the circumstances of his or her death

name: Parents’ remains
description: Before the hero destroys the antagonists or escapes from them, he finds or receives the remains or possessions that belonged to the antagonists' victim

name: Father’s weapon
description: A young hero obtains and uses weapons or other powerful objects which belonged to his murdered father

name: Brothers spy for night chief
description: Somebody regularly steals valuables (horse, hay, apples, etc.). Brothers one by one spy for the thief but only the youngest surprises him

name: To guard father’s grave
description: Before passing away a man asks his sons to guard his grave for a certain time or to bring something to his grave. The youngest son goes and obtains valuables

name: The dummy
description: A youth or two siblings live in a house of an old man or woman. To produce a reaction from this older person, they kill a person or animal and stuff its skin with insects, worms, ashes, grass or blow it up

name: Old woman beats the dummy
description: A youth or two siblings live in a house of an old woman. they kill her a person or animal who is her husband and make a dummy of him. The old woman is angry that her husband does not answer her, beats him and understands that it is a dummy

name: Frightened grandmother
description: After killing their enemy, heroes have fun frightening their (grand)mother or father with its dummy

name: Helpful tree-frog
description: A tree-frog kills or neutralizes dangerous person or creature who chases heroes

name: Turtle as antagonist
description: Hero's parents are killed by turtle who pulled them under the water

name: Antagonist carried away by bird
description: A man turns into powerful bird or creates it. The bird carries away his enemy

name: Talons got stuck
description: A mighty bird thrust its talons into a big fish, whale, water monster, etc. Talons get stuck, the bird is either pulled down under the water or makes itself free with great difficulty

name: Who killed a rabbit?
description: Antagonist makes a girl or a woman his or her slave. The slave's brothers or sons secretly come to her, kill for her some small game. Woman tries to pursue the antagonist that she herself killed the game

name: Enemy from the sky
description: A dangerous being who lives in the sky carries away a person or many people (or person's cut off head or limb). A young kin of the perished one revenges on the dangerous being and/or brings back the victim (his or her head, etc.)

name: Avenged prisoners
description: After the hero comes back after a long absence and finds his parents enslaved, he tells them to demonstrate openly a lack of respect to their masters and punishes those who were cruel with them

name: Foxes jeer at the abandoned person
description: When the hero returns home after a long absence, his relation does not believe at first that it is really he because all this time somebody jeered at him or her imitating the hero's voice, telling that the hero is back, etc.

name: Son transforms mother into a bird
description: When hero returns, he finds his mother being tormented during his absence and transforms her (and usually himself) into a certain bird

name: Son returns and burns tormentors using magic
description: When hero returns and finds his mother being tormented during his absence, he burns the tormentors producing fire and heat by magic

name: Waters split apart
description: When person comes to the water body, waters are split apart so the person reaches the other bank walking on the dry ground

name: Bait for antagonists
description: To kill his antagonists, hero lures them with an attractive object which is delicious to eat and is usually on the other side of a body of water or a canyon

name: The broken bridge
description: Person or his helper draws his enemies on the unstable bridge and destroys it. The enemies fall into water, into a precipice

name: The stretched out leg (crane bridge)
description: Person stretches his or her leg or neck as a bridge across water body. The fugitives or those who walk ahead cross the bridge; the persecutor or those who are behind usually fall because the person takes his bridge off

name: Enemy drowns
description: Antagonist perishes falling into the water or trying to cross a water body

name: Pursuer falls from height
description: Person ascends to the sky (rare: descends from the sky; ascends the cliff) by a rope, a ladder, etc. Another person tries to follow him or her but the rope (the ladder) is broken or severed

name: Beanstalk to the sky
description: A bean or a pea grows up to the sky and a person climbs by it there

name: Parrot cuts the sky rope
description: Person ascends to the sky or descends from the sky to earth by a rope. A parrot cuts the rope, the person falls to earth

name: Moon’s wife cannot follow him
description: The Moon's wife or sister tries to follow him to the sky but is unable to do it

name: An attempt to revive the victim
description: Twin heroes' parent dies or is killed, an attempt to revive him or her fails

name: Sons embrace their mother
description: Mother dies when her sons embrace or push her

name: Father more dead than alive
description: An attempt to revive the killed father (and uncle) is only partly successful and the revived person is unable to live among the living. The hero decides to abandon him in the other world or to let him die forever

name: One piece is missing
description: Person or animal is eaten up or destroyed otherwise. His bones are put together and he or it is revived. Because one bone was broken, swallowed or lost, the person or animal cannot be revived or being revived misses some part of his or its body

name: Ladder made of limbs of a girl
description: To help a man to ascend a rock, a girl tells him to cut her into pieces, make a ladder of her limbs, then put them together again. The girl revives but a finger is missing

name: Two animal persons and their children
description: A strong and aggressive animal person (often a bear) treacherously kills his (or her) companion who is a weaker animal person. The victim's children revenge on the murderer killing his (her) own children

name: Bear as antagonist
description: A bear-person (usually Bear-woman) kills her or his female companion who is associated with a weaker animal – not a predator or a weaker predator. The victim's children revenge on the antagonist killing her own children and / or run away and escape

name: Hare-woman or hare-children as heroes
description: A girl, a young woman, or children who are associated with a hare or rabbit are heroes of the story

name: The fawns and the cubs
description: Deer person is killed by the stronger animal person. The deer's children revenge on the murderer and (or) successively escape from him or her

name: One of two female companions kills another
description: Two co-wives of female companions live together, both have children. Once when they go to work outdoors (usually to gather wild plants), one of them kills and devours another. The victim's children escape

name: The calf and the tiger cub
description: Two women (usually female animal persons) live together, both have children, one of them kills and devours another. The son of the murderer kills his mother and becomes a companion of the victim's son, or the victim’s and the murderer’s children escape together

name: Kills own mother to rescue his half-brother
description: A hero and a son of the antagonist live together. They are half-brothers friends. When the antagonist makes attempt to kill the hero, the antagonist's son kills his own mother (or his both parents) or helps his human brother to do it

name: Unrecognized hero comes across enemies
description: Hero comes across different creatures or persons who do not recognize him. Everyone tells that he is waiting for the Hero to kill him. The hero easily kills or transforms them himself

name: Father tests his sons
description: Twin heroes (or one boy) come to their divine father. He puts them under trials to get know if they are really his children and possess supernatural power

name: Transformed into griddles
description: Brothers turn into cooking pots or griddles which are put on fire. Only the eldest is strong enough to stand this trial

name: Son of the Sun
description: A virgin girl is impregnated by the Sun and gives birth to a son or twin boys. When her son (or the twins) grows up, he (they) comes to his father

name: The arrow ladder
description: Persons make chain of arrows or darts shooting them one into another and making a chain or rope of them. Usually, they ascend by this rope to the upper world

name: The sky door
description: Chain of arrows is used to pull or push the sky or the Sun lower or higher or to break a hole in the sky

name: Following arrow gets to the sky
description: To climb to the sky, person needs first to shoot an arrow that would reach the sky and stick into it

name: Flight after arrow
description: Shooting and arrow, person flies on it, after it or ahead of it

name: Two-fold impregnation
description: A woman is impregnated by two different males and gives birth to twin sons who have different fathers

name: Light as a feather
description: Person is able to move or to hover in the air like a feather or a bit of fluff

name: The enchanted people
description: An antagonist transforms his victims into stones or (rare) plants, animals, monsters. Hero escapes transformation, revives the victims

name: Son saves, daughter betrays
description: Enemies attack household. The master's wife agrees to live with the enemies' leader, her former husband lies outdoors alive but tied up. His daughter refuses to release him, but his son does it. The man kills the enemies, usually cruelly kills his wife and daughter

name: The column of smoke
description: Person ascends to the sky on a column of smoke (but not being burned in a fire)

name: Sun’s children destroy the enemies
description: A lonely woman with her daughter are the only survivors after enemies' attack. The woman rejects a series of animal-persons who come to ask her daughter in marriage but accept a sky-person for her son-in-law. Children of the sky-person and woman's daughter revenge on the enemies

name: The bitten through bow-strings
description: Hero or his helpers cut or gnaw through bow- and other strings of the enemies, make holes in their canoes, making the enemies unable to fight or to pursue the hero

name: Stones on eyes
description: At night person puts light stones or shells on his eyes. The antagonist believes that his eyes are opened and does not dare to attack

name: One who comes to look at adversary’s bones dies himself
description: A man is marooned on an islet, a rock but survives thanks to helpful birds and animals. The next time the hero and the antagonist exchange roles. Usually the antagonist comes to the islet to see the bones of the abandoned man but the man takes the canoe of the antagonist and paddles away. The antagonist dies

name: Woman’s brothers maroon her husband
description: Brothers of a man's wife hate him and maroon on an islet

name: Marooned on islet
description: Person is marooned on an islet or on another side of a sea or wide river

name: Conflict because of a woman
description: A man maroons another because of jealousy or because he plans to take hold of his wife

name: Antagonist charged by stag
description: Hero turns into stag or creates a stag to charge his kinsman who sent hi into a trap

name: Imprisoned in the tree-hollow
description: Person is imprisoned in a tree-hollow or inside a rock and is released by somebody who makes a hole from outside

name: Tree to descend from a rock
description: A tree or vine quickly grows up near the rock or in the bottom of a pit where the hero was marooned. He gets to the ground climbing down (or up) this tree (vine)

name: A marooned man returns home before his adversary
description: A man marooned on an islet or rock in the sea turns into a bird and flies home. When the man who marooned him comes home, the hero is already there

name: The destroyed ladder
description: Hero climbs up (e.g. to a tree) or down (e.g. into a deep cave) by ladder, rope, from branch to branch, etc. The rope etc. breaks or is intentionally destroyed and the hero cannot return to the ground. (all cases of motif K2A are also computed together with K2)

name: Hero marooned in the underworld
description: A man descends down into the well, precipice, etc. Saving a girl or girls, getting treasure etc. he sends them up. After receiving girls and treasure, companions cut the rope and the hero remains below

name: Tree or rock grows taller
description: Hero climbs up a tree or rock to get eggs, nestlings, fruits, honey, etc. Another person makes the tree (rock) grow higher or thicker and the hero is unable to descend back

name: The bird nester
description: Person climbs up a tree or rock or descends to a cave to get eggs or nestlings from the bird's nest. Another person remains on the ground. They get into conflict and/or the first person is unable to get back to the ground

name: The fake nestlings
description: To lure the hero into a trap or to send him far away, the antagonist makes a bird or nestlings of excrements or guts

name: Vine from body excretions
description: A vine grows from person's or animal's tears, mucus, urine, etc.

name: “Like pubis of your wife”
description: Hero compares something with pubis of another man's wife or sister. The insulted man maroons him in a tree or rock.

name: Jonah: swallowed by monster
description: Person gets into the belly of water being or into the belly of giant creature which appearance and living place remain vague. He kills the monster from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)

name: Jonah: swallowed by bird
description: Person gets into the belly of a giant bird. He kills it from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)

name: Woman is soul of a whale
description: Raven gets inside a whale where he sees a woman who asks him not to touch an inner organ of the whale (usually its heart) or a burning lamp. Raven touches it, woman disappears, the whale dies

name: Jonah: swallowed by terrestrial animal
description: Person gets into the belly of ground animal or bird. He kills it from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)

name: First swallowed by herbivorous animal and then by wolf
description: Tiny boy is first swallowed by chance by a big herbivorous animal and then carried away by a wolf who began to eat the animal's offal

name: Jonah: swallowed by anthropomorphic being
description: Person (often an animal-person) gets into the belly of anthropomorphic being. He kills it from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)

name: Gets inside via anus
description: Person or animal gets into another being through its anus

name: Deer in monster’s belly
description: A swallowed up person finds alive deer in the belly of the monster

name: God’s wife thrown down from the sky
description: The sky chief discovers or thinks that his wife, sister or lover is untrue or incestuous. He throws her down from the sky. She becomes the mistress of the lower or middle world or a part of it or one of her sons gets power over the lower world

name: Battle with a bird: a shelter
description: Heroes kill a dangerous bird. During or before confrontation they hide inside a shelter (hut, cage, vessel, bag, hollow log) or cover themselves with a protective object

name: Cage carried away
description: A giant bird carries away to its nest a cage or bag with people inside

name: Wrapped in guts
description: Hero (or twins) hangs on his body a bag with animal bowels full of blood. Breaking them with its claws, the bird thinks that its victim is killed and brings the man to its nest. He kills the adult bird, kills or transforms its nestlings

name: Bird carries man to an island
description: A flying monster carries a man to a far away island. There he gets to kill the monster. To return, he uses a boat, a bridge or a rope made of parts of the monster's body

name: Rescued people
description: Getting to a nest of a monstrous bird, a man finds there kidnapped people, helps them to return home

name: Nestlings turn into eagles
description: Hero transforms nestlings or monster bird into common eagles or owls

name: Feathers turn into birds
description: Feathers of giant bird turn into different present day birds

name: Woman lost and returned
description: A rival or adversary kidnaps man's wife or bride or takes her sending her man off. The man gets her back

name: A strained  bow
description: An unrecognized hero comes to a place where his bride or wife has to marry another man or is tuned into a slave. Despite expectations, he gets to strain a tight bow killing his rivals

name: Person with cut off leg ascends to the sky
description: Certain person's leg or (rare) both legs are cut, torn, or bitten off. He ascends to the sky, usually becomes a constellation or a luminary or gets to the luminary

name: Leg bitten off by caiman
description: A caiman ferries a man across water body, bites his leg off. The maimed man is transformed into a constellation or into an animal

name: Ogress’ daughter avenges death of her mother
description: A man marries an ogress' daughter, kills her mother. The wife revenges on him, gets to cut off his leg

name: Leg hangs in the sky
description: A group of boys gets to the sky. The leg of the last one is cut or torn off

name: Precious advices
description: A man gives his last money for simple advices. Each of them saves his life or helps to achieve success or he does not follow the advices and gets into trouble

name: Thrown into the oven himself
description: An antagonist orders to kill the first one who will come in the morning to a certain place. The hero becomes late by chance, the antagonist or his wife or son come and are thrown into the fire

name: Substituted weapon
description: Hero substitutes powerful person's weapon with a fake

name: Substituted barrel of water
description: Because containers with alive and dead water (one makes one stronger, another weaker) are imperceptibly exchanged, during the battle the hero drinks the alive water and overcomes his enemy who drinks the dead water

name: Clothes of stone
description: The owner of the stone (ice) clothes kills people. The hero hides his stone clothes and kills him

name: Girl’s pet turns into a young man
description: Disguised as a bird, small animal or insect, the hero lets himself be caught by a girl to have sex with her or to steal valuables possessed by her family or he lets himself be caught by the girl's father to receive opportunity to get to his daughter

name: Slips and drops dummy
description: Being eager to show that he is a successful hunter, a man walks in front of a girl carrying a game (deer, birds). The girl makes him slip, he drops the false game that proves to be a dummy stuffed with ashes or a termite nest

name: Ornitomorphic suitor
description: Ornithomorphic hero impregnates a girl magically or imperceptibly for her

name: Infant picks out his unknown father
description: To get know who is the father or (rare) mother of a small boy, many people come together. Everybody is eager to be recognized as the boy's parent but the boy points at his real father or mother

name: Infant takes father’s bow and arrows
description: When a small boy has to recognize his father among many men, he comes to him and takes father's bow and arrows

name: To cease crying
description: A baby boy has to recognize his father or mother among many people. When his parent takes him, the boy ceases crying

name: Urinates at his father’s arms
description: A baby boy has to recognize his father among many men. When his father takes him, the boy urinates at his arms

name: Star-wife
description: A man maries a star-woman

name: Star-husband
description: A woman maries a star-man

name: Star-wife hidden in a bag
description: During the day time a man hides his star-wife in a bag, gourd-vessel, and the like

name: Star’s husband suffers from cold
description: When a man who has married a star gets to the sky, he suffers severe cold and dies either of cold or after touching a forbidden fire

name: Wolverine under a tree
description: When a woman or two sisters descend from sky back to earth, they get to the top of a tree. Some animals who walk by cannot help them or do not want to help. Wolverine gets women down because he plans to marry them but they escape from him

name: Stars help to work
description: Star person or persons descend to earth to work at the garden plot

name: Two stars of different color and brightness
description: Two stars are men, an old and a young ones. They look different as about their color or brightness but these characteristics do not correlate (the bright star can prove to be an old man and vice versa. Usually two girls wish these stars for husbands and express different preferences (one prefers bright blue star, another wants small and red one, etc.)

name: Wish for star-husband or wife realized
description: A human person admires a star or (rare) the Moon in the sky, wishes for a star. The star descends to him or her or takes him or her to the sky

name: Woman descends from the sky by rope
description: A sky-dweller marries a woman. Being eager to return to the earth, she secretly climbs down to earth by a rope

name: Dwarfs and cranes
description: Different from (common) people inhabitants of a distant land fight with non-human enemies who periodically attack them

name: Dwarfs attacked
description: Birds or other creatures which not dangerous for common people attack dwarfs who live in another world

name: Humans in the south, birds in the north
description: A man gets to the country inhabited by migratory birds. They have there human guise but turn into birds going back to the north

name: Man helps inhabitants of other world
description: Inhabitants of a distant land who have different nature than (normal) human beings struggle from time to time with some non-human enemies. Man helps local dwellers because their enemies are not dangerous for the human beings

name: Birds attacked
description: Inhabitants of a distant country suffer from periodic assaults of the enemies which are not dangerous for common people. These enemies (and sometimes the inhabitants of the country too) are birds

name: Battle with birds
description: Birds attack the inhabitants of a distant land or a man who had got to this land

name: Feathers are the birds’ weapon
description: Birds use their feathers as arrows or their arrows and down stick mouth openings of them enemies

name: Stolen clothes of supernatural woman
description: Women who possess supernatural power and usually come from a non-human world (from sky, from under the water, they are winged beings, bird- or animal-persons) take off their clothes (feather skins and the like) or part of it. After the man hides clothes, their owner has to marry him or help him

name: Supernatural male hides clothes of human girl
description: Supernatural male person (often a snake, a dragon) hides clothes of a human girl or sits on it. To return her clothes she had to become his wife

name: To dance in her magic clothes
description: Magic wife gets her wings back and flies away after she pretends that putting her real clothes she would be more beautiful, a better dancer, etc.

name: Woman from sky-world marries mortal man
description: A man gets a woman connected with the upper world (bird-maiden, sky fairy, star-woman, etc.), she becomes his wife or (rare) adopted daughter

name: Magic wife finds her clothes
description: Magic wife abandons her mortal husband when she finds her clothes (often, her feathers if she is a bird-woman), makes herself the new clothes, receives them from her kin or her husband gives her her clothing believing that she will not abandon him. (Versions with magic wife abandoning her husband because she feels herself offended is not alternative to the “found clothes but in most of the texts these motifs are not combined)

name: Thrown down feathers
description: Magic wife flies away or makes attempt to fly away when her bird relatives throw down her feathers (wings)

name: Woman pursues a porcupine and gets to the sky
description: Pursuing a porcupine, woman climbs a tree and gets to the upper world

name: Baby under a tussock
description: Digging roots or gathering sea food on a beach, a woman finds baby-boy. Usually her mother warns her not to dig a certain bulb or not to do it in a certain way. Breaking taboo, the woman finds or conceives baby-boy

name: Prohibited bulb in the sky
description: Person gets to the sky, makes hole through the firmament digging out a root. Usually woman's husband or his kinsmen warn her against digging out a special bulb or tuber; breaking taboo, she gets to see the earth, decides to descend

name: A hole in the firmament
description: Finding a hole in the ground or making it, person gets to see below another world. Usually the earth is seen from the sky

name: Sky opening covered with a stone
description: Opening in the firmament is covered with a flat stone. When person puts the stone aside, he or she gets to see the earth

name: Ordeal: survive frosty night
description: An ordeal: to survive frosty night outdoors or in chamber with ice

name: Ordeal: to smoke a pipe
description: An ordeal: to smoke a huge or poisonous pipe or to remain alive in poisonous smoke

name: Ordeal: knives and thorns
description: An ordeal: to remain alive after contact with sharp points or blades

name: Ordeal: chamber with dangerous beings
description: An ordeal: to remain alive in a closed room full of beasts of prey, poisonous or other dangerous creatures

name: Ordeal: to eat much
description: An ordeal: to eat or drink much or eat or drink poisonous beverage or food

name: Difficult task: to build a bridge
description: A task-giver asks to build a bridge (usually of gold etc.) during a very short time

name: Ordeal: to bathe in boiling water
description: Person is ordered to bathe in a boiling liquid or to jump into fire but he remains unharmed. Usually the adversary attempts to repeat the trick but dies

name: A task: to carve a bench
description: A task: to carve a bench decorated with representa­tion of the head of the father(or mother)-in-law that is always concealed

name: To sort grain
description: A task-giver asks to sort a large amount or small particles of different kind (usually seeds of different plants) mixed in container or to count such particles or to pick up the spilled grains

name: Task: to dry a body of water
description: A task: to dry a body of water

name: Diving contest
description: A contest: to dive deep or for a long time

name: Task: to get object from bottom of body of water
description: A task: to get an object from the bottom of a water body

name: Water covered with ice
description: When hero dives, the antagonist covers the water surface with ice or net

name: Task: to kill an animal of unusual color
description: A task: to kill an animal of special (often unusual) color or form

name: Tasks of the in-laws
description: Father or other kinsmen of hero's wife or bride try to kill or test him and/or suggest him difficult tasks

name: Task-giver is a king or a chief
description: Person who gives difficult tasks to the hero is a prominent figure in social hierarchy, i.e. a head of political unit of community- or higher level and not a mythical being

name: Envious minister
description: Not the powerful person himself but his official or adviser tries to get rid of the hero and suggests that the person should give the hero difficult tasks

name: Ball game
description: A contest: ball game

name: Antagonist mourns loss of his helpers
description: The antagonist sends the hero to the place where he is attacked by dangerous creatures. The hero kills them and brings to the antagonist. The creatures are the antagonist's relatives, pets, or helpers, therefore he or she mourns their death or revives them

name: Antagonist in animal guise
description: Antagonist asks the hero to kill or to tame a dangerous animal or not to kill certain animal during a hunt. This animal is the antagonist himself (or his daughter or wife)

name: Task: to bring milk of dangerous animal
description: A task: to bring milk of dangerous animal

name: света
description: To visit the world of the dead

name: Contest: a race
description: Contest: a race

name: To overcome an old woman
description: A mighty man has to wrestle or race with an old woman who proves to be very strong

name: Climbing contest
description: A contest: to climb a pole or tree

name: Hide-and-seek
description: Hero and his adversary play hide-and-seek. The hero finds his adversary but the adversary cannot find him

name: One day from conception to birth
description: A demand is brought up that a baby would be born the next day after conception or would talk immediately after the birth

name: Task: to hit an aim
description: A task: to hit with an arrow or a stone an animal, a bird, or object (usually placed at the top of a tree or pole)

name: Dancing apples
description: A task: to bring objects (usually fruits) that act like people, i.e. dance, sing and the like

name: Monster brought by the hero kills the task-giver
description: Task-giver asks to bring him dangerous being or object possessed by a moster or deity. Hero fulfills the task. The beast, monster, deity or the object itself kills the task-giver

name: Former husband of magic wife
description: A man marries a non-human woman. In her world, she has another husband or suitor. She returns to her world, human husband follows her. He stands tests and/or fights with local inhabitants, gets his wife back

name: Invisible servant (“Bring don’t know what”)
description: Hero receives a difficult task (usually to bring an object or creature that have no particular indications and properties) and comes across an invisible person who is a powerful and well-disposed servant to anybody who becomes his master. The hero is kind with him and the person helps him

name: To steal an egg from under a bird
description: Person is able to steal an egg (a nestling, to put it back) from under the bird (to change the bird’s feather; to steal an embryo from animal’s womb, etc.)

name: The man persecuted because of his beautiful bride
description: A powerful person coverts a beautiful bride or wife of a man and gives him impossible tasks to get rid of him

name: To climb a tree with a full glass in hand
description: Person must climb a tree (pole, rock) with a full open vessel in hand and not a drop should be spilled

name: To get material for making bow and arrows
description: Hero is sent or sets off by his own will to get two or more different materials needed for making bow and arrows (wood or reed for shafts, feathers, tendons for string, flint for points, paint to paint the shafts, gum to stick points to the shafts)

name: To get a bird from a tree
description: Hero is sent to a dangerous tree or rock to bring feathers, nestling, fruits, bark, etc.

name: Game of chance
description: Confrontation between the hero and his antagonist has a from of a game of chance

name: Not to take a cage, a bridle
description: Trying to steal a wonderful bird (horse), hero breaks his helper’s instruction (usually not to take anything else besides the animal or object itself) and is caught but released on condition that he brings another wonderful object. Situation is repeated and the last task is to bring a girl. Ultimately the hero gets both the girl and all the objects

name: Wife gives birth to her husband’s son  while husband is absent
description: A man who is far away from his wife visits her using magic or a wife visits her husband incognito. She gives birth to his son but people believe she was untrue to her husband. Ultimately her chastity is recognized

name: The cat with the candle
description: A man trains a cat (monkey, dog) to hold lighted candle (lamp) on its head. When a mouse (a rat) runs through the room, the cat drops the candle and chases the mouse

name: Trained animal of the gambler
description: Person always wins a game thanks to a cat (or a mouse) who carries the lamp (or puts the light out in a certain moment). The hero releases a mouse (or correspondingly a cat), the cat runs after it and the person loses the game

name: An agreement to marry the would be born children
description: Two men agree to marry their future children if a girl and a boy will be born. The boy is poor or he loses his former status after his father’s death, the girl’s parents decide to evade the given obligation. The boy grows up and finds his bride

name: The stone of patience
description: Being a victim of the injustice and after much suffering a young woman tells about her fate to certain inanimate objects (often it is “the stone of patience”) or her story is told by her husband. The woman is rescued and the justice restored

name: Ogress and blinded wives
description: A married man marries another woman who is a transformed ogress/witch. Thanks to her intrigues other wives (the first wife) are blinded and/or confined in an underground hole. A son of one of them overcomes the ogress, returns sight to his mother and her sisters

name: Father or uncle is rival and enemy
description: Maternal uncle or father (or grandfather if he replaces father who is not mentioned) of the young man is his rival or enemy and tries to kill him

name: Survives in a fire
description: Hero demonstrates his supernatural abilities remaining alive in a burning hot chamber, stove, bonfire, among burning vegetation

name: Posthole murder
description: Hero is asked to climb into a hole or pit. When he does it, they fill it with soil or throw down a post, a stone, etc. The hero demonstrates his magic capacities coming back uninjured

name: Brings tree that was fallen on him
description: To kill a strong man, others fell a tree and hope that the man will be crashed when it falls on him, or they tie him to a tree. The man remains unharmed and brings the tree home

name: The drunk elephants
description: When water in a spring is replaced with alcohol, a big animal becomes drunk and is caught

name: Flying enemy abducts woman
description: Flying person or creature abducts a woman but is ultimately killed or the woman escapes from him

name: The chief’s wife and vultures
description: Wife of a chief abandons him with vultures (usually by her own will being untrue to her husband). The chief (Witoto: her own brother) brings her back

name: Wooden seal
description: Person makes a sea mammal or fish of wood, it carries another person or persons into the open sea or kills him or them

name: The false wife
description: An ugly, old, lazy, etc. woman or a male trickster comes to man under disguise of his wife, bride or (more rare) sister who is driven out, confined to the underworld, killed, etc.

name: Husband goes away for a moment
description: Man travels with his wife. The imposter replaces her when her husband goes away for a short time

name: Mother substitutes daughterMother takes the appearance of her daughter to replace her
True wife turns into owl
description: When the imposter takes place of the real wife, the latter turns into owl

name: True bride sent to work
description: A girl (rare: boy) is walking to her or his relations or to her bridegroom. On the way the imposter lures her (him) to exchange clothes and takes her (his) place while the real girl (boy) is sent to look after crops or domestic animals. People hear her (his) song in which all the story is told. The deception is disclosed, the imposter killed

name: Ones of gold, of silver, of wood
description: Negative person or place is contrasted with one or two positive ones as wood with silver and gold

name: Bird-son rescues his adopted mother
description: An evil spirit abandons a girl or a young woman in a tree or islet. She takes care for a nestling of bird of prey, he grows big, rescues her

name: Punishment: torn apart by horses
description: To punish an antagonist, he or she is tied to a horse (camel, bull) or to several horses (camels, etc.) who torn him or her apart

name: Punishment: buried alive
description: To punish an antagonist, he or she is buried alive

name: Two sitters at the bed of a sleeping prince
description: A girl finds a body of a sleeping youth who will wake up at a certain time and marry  the girl who would sit nearby. Usually at the last moment the girl goes away for a time and the impostor takes her place.

name: Drowned woman remains alive
description: A young woman is transformed into an animal, pushed into the water, into the underworld or she herself has to plunge into water. She is not dead, answers a call, comes out to nurse her baby, to help her children. In most cases her husband discovers her, brings her back to earth or helps her to acquire her human form

name: Younger brother transformed into animal
description: Siblings (most often younger brother and elder sister) leave their home. One of them (most often the brother, most rare several brothers) turn into animal (usually an ungulate) or (rare) a bird but (in the most cases) ultimately acquires his or her human form again

name: Children born in a well
description: Pregnant woman is thrown into a well (pond, hole, etc.) where she gives birth to a son (children). She and her children brought alive

name: Friends abandon a pretty girl
description: A girl goes with her friends to a river, into a forest, etc. Other girls return home but the heroine has to remain or to go back to the forest, etc. She has a narrow escape from a dangerous creature. marries a supernatural being or a chief, or dies but is avenged

name: Girl from a fruit
description: Young man gets a girl who is inside a fruit or a flower

name: Donkey’s skin
description: A man discovers that a beautiful girl hides herself under a guise of an ugly and dirty servant, under a skin of an animal or in an object that is brought into his house

name: Disappeared and returned children
description: Babies disappear but are ultimately returned to their mother or father grown up and in good health

name: Basin of honey and basin of oil
description: Person promises to fill one basin (fountain, dry river-bed, etc.) with honey and another with oil (milk, etc.) if his wish would be granted. He fulfills the promise either really or formally (honey etc. from broken containers is spilled on earth)

name: Fruits of two kinds
description: One who eats certain fruit (leave, etc.) gets horns (long nose, etc.) or turns into an animal. After eating another fruit (leave) person recovers his or her normal body

name: The cat, the dog and the magic object
description: A man obtains an object that fulfills desires. The object is stolen but brought back by the animals which had been formerly saved by the man

name: Fatal swing
description: Person kills others inviting them to sit on a swing and launching them into water, on rocks, etc.

name: False husband
description: Imposter takes appearance of the hero to take his position and/or to marry or to violate a woman

name: Hero brands his rivals
description: Person who is an excellent food provider or warrior agrees to let the others material proves of his exploits (the killed game, etc.) for the right to brand them or injure their bodies in a certain way or to take from them objects that they should not give off

name: The most delicious dish
description: Hero gives his rivals the food provided by him by order of the king but the king finds this food poisonous, useless or tasteless while the food presented by the hero is excellent even if it looks not so good

name: Ogre in a well
description: An ogre (a dragon) kills everybody who comes to him. The hero is not killed but receives a reward because he greeted the ogre and/or gave a correct answer to his question

name: Герой (героиня) временно превращен(а) в животное (обычно в собаку/койота или в осла и т.д.). Обычно когда ему или ей помогают вернуть прежний облик, в животное превращен антагонист. В части текстов метаморфозу испытывает либо только герой, либо только антагонист
description: Bewitched into animal

name: To recognize his own among several identical ones
description: To return or to get his or her son, wife, husband, domestic animal or (rare) object, person must recognize her, him or it among several identical persons, animals or objects

name: To recognize a man
description: Person must recognize her (or his) son or husband among several identical persons or (if the son or husband is temporarily transformed) animals

name: To recognize an object or an animal
description: Person must recognize a particular object or animal among several similar objects or animals

name: Hero helps nestlings
description: Person does good to nestlings of a powerful bird, the grateful mother bird helps him

name: White and black rams
description: Getting to the underworld, hero should take a white ram (horse) which would carry him back to earth. By chance, he takes the black one which carries him even deeper to the lower level of the underworld

name: Snake threatens nestlings
description: A serpent or water monster regularly devours or injures children of powerful being (almost always: nestlings of giant bird). The bird has no power over the serpent but hero kills the monster

name: Bird steals colts, hero kills the serpent
description: Every time when a horse gives birth to wonderful colts, they are stolen by a giant bird. A hero goes to get the colts and kills a serpent that regularly devours nestlings of the giant bird

name: Birds carries hero to its place, hero kills the monster
description: Bird carries a man to its place where he kills a monster who regularly devoured the nestlings

name: Bird carries hero to his destination
description: Hero helps a powerful bird (usually does good to her nestlings), grateful bird carries him to the place where he is eager to get or tells to do it one of her nestlings

name: Monster blocks waters
description: A monster blocks sources of water and usually gives some in exchange for human victims or valuables. Hero kills the monster

name: Of copper, of silver, of gold
description: Loci or objects of three (rare – four) different materials are mentioned in such a way that all of them have positive connotations though unequal value (copper, silver and gold; silver, gold and diamonds, etc.)

name: Forest of metal trees
description: Person travels across a forest with trees of two or more kinds of metal (copper, silver, etc.)

name: The packed kingdom
description: Coming back from the underworld, abducted princess puts objects that she used there (clothes, house, “kingdom”) into a small container (an egg, a ball, etc.) and brings them with her

name: Man feeds his own flesh to his animal helper
description: Person has to feed powerful creature (usually a giant bird) giving it regularly pieces of meat. When meat supply is exhausted, he cuts off a piece of his own flesh

name: One laughs, another weeps
description: Hero sees two persons or creatures one of which laughs and another cries. The one who cries will be eaten by monster today and the one who laughs he will be eaten tomorrow. The hero kills the monster

name: Thunder against a serpent
description: Thunder or giant bird fights against a reptile, big water animal or other big and strong creature who lives in water or under the earth

name: Bird-woman kills men (The loon-woman)
description: Bird-woman is energetically searching a man whom she likes, takes him by force for her husband. Turning into a monster, she kills men but is ultimately destroyed

name: Compassionate person saves fire
description: People abandon a boy, a girl, brother and sister, a group of children, or a young family without fire and food. A compassionate person conceals hot coals for the outlaws in the abandoned camp

name: Bird brings some meat
description: People abandon a boy, a girl, brother and sister, a group of children, or a young family without fire and food. The outlaws demonstrate supernatural powers or protectors providing food and lodging. While the abandoned persons have plenty of food other people starve. A person (often a bird like crow, magpie, sea-gull, etc.) visits the abandoned ones and brings from them some food home. This way people get to know that the abandoned ones prosper

name: Dog unfastens children
description: Abandoned children are tied to a tree. Helpful dog or other animal unfastens them

name: False parent
description: Spirit or animal person steals a boy, tells him that she or he is his real mother or father. The boy gets to know the truth, leaves the false parent

name: Frog pretends to be mother
description: An amphibian (frog, toad, rare newt) steals or finds a boy, lies him that she is his real mother

name: Sedna (fingers cut off)
description: A man throws a woman into the water. She tries to snatch at something, he cuts her fingers off. Usually the woman or/and the cut off fingers turn into water creatures

name: Woman throws herself into the ocean
description: Giving way to a burst of horror or shame, woman or girl runs to the ocean, throws herself into the water or remains on the beach. Her husband or suitor pursues but cannot catch her

name: A woman and a dog
description: A woman takes a dog paramour, marries him, gives birth to his children. The puppies turn into human children and usually become ancestors of some groups of people

name: Dog turns into handsome man
description: A girl marries a handsome man whom she had first seen in guise of a dog

name: Origin of dogs
description: A woman marries a dog, gives birth to the ancestors of present dogs who are people's helpers and friends

name: Dog fulfills conditions of marriage
description: A girl marries a dog because only the dog fulfilled the condition of marriage put by the girl's father

name: Singing bird of the hero
description: Hero has or obtains an unusual bird. An imposter steals it, takes the hero’s place but the bird is mute or cries differently. The hero returns, his bird sings again

name: Birds decorate hero’s attire
description: Alive birds and beasts decorate hero's costume and headgear. Imposter steals hero's attire, takes his place but the birds and beasts are mute or cry differently

name: Dead mother returns to nurse her baby
description: Dead or driven away woman returns to the human world to her baby that needs mother's care

name: False wife beheads enemy
description: A man disguised as a woman comes to his enemy and kills him at night (usually cuts off and carries away his head)

name: The deceived wife
description: A Man disappears or goes away for long time. His wife sets off, comes to a house where her husband lives now or first sends her son there. She gets to know that he has married another woman

name: Pushes into a boiling pot
description: The abandoned wife comes to the new one when the husband is not at home. She kills her rival pushing her head into boiling liquid or pouring it into her ear

name: Rescue from the sea bottom
description: When a woman or a lad comes to the sea bank, she or he is carried away by sea predators (killer-whales, sharks, swordfish). Man descends to the bottom and rescues the woman or lad using his shaman's power

name: Slave pours water on fireplace
description: A man descends to the bottom of the sea to rescue his wife. He makes arrangements with a slave who pours water on fireplace producing steam. Hidden behind the steam, the man escapes with his wife

name: Broken adze
description: A man comes to the non-human beings to get a woman. He secures the help of a slave repairing his adze or axe

name: Animal skins as metamorphosis amulets
description: Person temporarily turns into a bird or an animal putting on corresponding skin or animal skins are amulets that become alive and help the person

name: Two giants
description: A man meets a dangerous giant (or serpent) who proves to be friendly to him. When another giant fights with the first one, the man helps his friend

name: Cut tendons
description: A man and a friendly giant live together. The friendly giant fights with another one and asks the man for help. This help proves to be crucial because the man badly injures a foot of another giant

name: Chastity rewarded
description: A powerful supernatural wants to check if his guest made love with his wife or daughter. The person is impotent or (successfully pretends to be) chaste and is rewarded or at least gets no harm. Usually the same episodes repeats with another person who is dissolute or unable to control himself. This person is punished

name: (Kind and unkind girls
description: A girl or a woman meets powerful person, behaves herself in a right way and is successful. Another (or two others) behaves in a wrong way and suffers a reverse (is punished or not rewarded). Rare: the protagonists are a stepchild and a family child of different sex

name: The unworthy girl fails, the worthy one succeeds
description: Two or three sisters are sent in succession to powerful person. The first or the first and the second sister behave in a wrong way, perish or do not succeed. The last one behaves correctly, gets a reward

name: The dog tests his bride
description: Two or three girls in succession become brides of the dog. The first one or two act in a wrong way, perish or do not succeed. The last one behaves correctly, gets a reward

name: Mother-in-law helps the girl to fulfill a task
description: Coming to powerful man, a girl must make work that she is unable to do. His mother makes the work for her, and she marries the man

name: If asked to do in a bad way, do otherwise
description: Person (usually a girl) gets to the powerful person (usually an old woman) who asks her to act in a strange and harsh way (to put room in disorder, to bring unclean water, and the like). The person does not according to order but in a rationale and polite way and is recompensed. Another person acts according to the direct sense of the words and is punished

name: Not to fix laces on clothes and shoes
description: Though laces on her clothes or shoes get loose, a girl on her way to the powerful persons or back should not tie them up

name: Dog the messenger
description: When the kind girl returns home, a dog barks saying that everything is well with her and when the unkind girl returns (or her dead body is brought home), the dog barks that everything is bad

name: Old woman becomes a young beauty
description: An old or ugly woman is transformed into a young beauty. Usually another old woman tries to imitate her but dies or suffers a reverse

name: Food asks to be eaten
description: On the way to the non-human world objects ask a child to taste certain food or to fulfill some work. The child does what was asked and is rewarded

name: Strawberries under the snow
description: In the winter time a girl (rare: a boy) is sent to bring something that is available only in summer. She brings it

name: Swallowed by boa
description: A girl marries an animal or brings an animal to her home that turns into a handsome man. Her sister or friend tries to do the same but perishes or suffers a reverse

name: Kind girl returns with a handsome man
description: One girl goes to the other world, acts correctly and brings back an animal or a box with a handsome man inside. Another girl acts wrongly and suffers a reverse

name: The worthy man is rewarded, the unworthy punished
description: First one, then another man meets a powerful person or persons. The first man is worthy and rewarded with treasure, prestige or the like. The second man (or two men) follows him, behaves in a wrong way and is punished

name: Golden axe
description: A man loses an axe. A spirit or a powerful official suggests him a golden axe but the man does not accept it. The spirit (official) gives him axes of gold and silver as a reward for his honesty. Usually another man intentionally loses his axe, claims the golden one but receives nothing

name: Broken leg of a nestling
description: A man cures injured bird, it brings him a seed from which something valuable grows. Another man intentionally injures and then cures a bird, kit brings him a seed from which something harmful grows

name: Two humpbacks
description: Two men have a similar defect (a hump, a lump). One spends a night in a place where spirits free him from his defect. Another comes to the same place but spirits double his defect giving him what they had taken off from the first man

name: To divide a chicken
description: A man divides a cooked chicken (goose) according to social ranks of the people (e.g. head of the household gets chicken’s head, his daughters get wings, etc.), takes himself not prestige but meaty parts and is rewarded. Another man brings several chickens but is unable to divide them in a proper way. The first man is called again, divides chickens with ingenuity and is rewarded again

name: Cinderella
description: A girl who conceals her beauty and/or is poor and oppressed by her stepmother puts on a splendid attire and comes incognito to a feast where a man of high status falls in love with her. He marries her after identifying her by an object given to her or lost by her or (rare) seeing how she changes her clothes

name: Construction of watercourse: a tragic love
description: Person builds a watercourse as a condition of marriage. When the work is fulfilled, the woman breaks her promise. She or her bridegroom usually die

name: Water for love
description: Person brings water or a river with fish to the place where a girl agrees to marry him and does not do it if the girl is unwilling

name: Box for Osiris
description: One man puts another into a box, closes the lid (or ties him to a board, to canoe, etc.) and puts the box adrift. It floats to another land, man is released there, returns home, revenges on his enemy

name: How strong are bonds?
description: Person lets be firmly tied up when another one say that it's only a joke (e.g. a test to see can the first one break bonds)

name: Invitation to coffin
description: Person is lured into a trap being invited to lie in a box or a hole to measure it. Being unable to liberate himself from the box etc., the person remains in power of his enemies

name: Touchy with king, patient with stableman
description: King’s wife is extremely touchy and cannot suffer a slightest pain. She does not say a word, however, when her lover who is a servant or a demon is beating her

name: To get know a secret
description: To get know the precise number of certain units, to select certain object among many others, to get know a name of particular person or a reason of particular phenomenon, person tries to surprise the possessor of the knowledge who becomes to speak aloud and unintentionally names the corresponding number, specifies the object, etc.

name: To get know names
description: Person is eager to get know names of several strangers. He hides himself and creates situations when the strangers call each other by name

name: To name a demon
description: A demon suggests to fulfill a difficult work if the person tells him his name after the work is done. At the last moment the person gets know the name by chance, the demon disappears and the person rewarded for being such a good worker. Or the demon comes to take a child but agrees to give it back if the parents guess his (the demon's) name

name: Hard work made her ugly
description: Young woman’s bridegroom or husband gets to believe that she is extraordinarily industrious. To conceal the deception, she herself or somebody else makes the man believe that because of hard work women become ugly or change into animals. The man prohibits his wife to work anymore

name: Woman rewarded for making a person laugh
description: When a powerful (supernatural) person gets to see a woman in a ridiculous situation, he or she becomes to laugh (and thus cured from his disease). The woman is rewarded, saved from a danger

name: Quarrel of mouse and bird
description: The war between animals and birds begins because a mouse (rat, mole, etc.) and a small bird cannot divide supplies for winter

name: Hunting wild people
description: A man gets to a country which inhabitants hunts of fish people whom they consider wild and equivalent to the real game or fish

name: Escape from Polyphemos’ cave
description: Person gets into dwelling of master of animals or monstrous shepherd. The host can kill him. The hero escapes sticking to hair of one of the animals who are going out

name: Blinded cyclops
description: Person blinds sleeping ogre and escapes from him

name: Object sticks to a body
description: Hero's adversary provokes him to touch an object that proves to be sticky. The hero sticks to it, sometimes has to cut off his finger

name: Genii loci
description: Being thrown out, put into certain places, born by primeval couple some beings turn into spirits of particular loci

name: Spirits fall from the sky
description: Being thrown down (usually from the sky), some beings get to different places and turn into spirits or animals with particular functions and names

name: People and spirits
description: Spirits or unpleasant animals (reptiles, worms, etc.) are (often: concealed from the eyes of God or deformed) children or miscarriages of the same human couple or the same primeval ancestor who produced first human beings

name: Unwashed children of Eve
description: A woman gives birth to many children but conceals part of them (rare: all) from God. The concealed children become poor people or non-human beings

name: Separating the rich from the poor
description: A woman gives birth to many children but conceals part of them from God. The concealed children become ancestors of the people of the lower social status while those that had been shown to God become ancestors of the high status people

name: Wrong marriage ritual and the birth of spirits
description: The primeval couple is married. First wife has miscarriages or gives birth to spirits, worms or other unpleasant animals. Later, usually after the proper marriage ceremony is organized, she becomes to give birth to real human beings or gods

name: Extraordinary companions
description: Several companions have extraordinary abilities (one who runs fast, one who eats great quantities, one who produces or can withstand severe frost, etc.)

name: Burned moccasins
description: Two men spend a night in a forest, take their moccasins or clothes off usually to dry them near the fire. One plans to burn the moccasins or the clothes of another at night. The latter imperceptible interchange their things and the first man burns his own property

name: Drowned wife
description: A socially weak man is a nuisance for stronger persons. He gets to know that they plan to drown him and tricks them to drown instead one of them or their own property

name: Bargain not to become angry
description: Person of a low social position (who has no supernatural abilities) agrees to a contest with a person of high social position (or with an ogre, etc.)that whoever becomes angry first must suffer a severe punishment. The weaker person abuses the stronger one until the latter erupts in anger.

name: Blood-clot defends his stepfather
description: A weak man abused by a strong one (often his son-in-law) brings home a clot of animal’s blood, from which a child is born. The blood-clot boy avenges the old man

name: A visit to God
description: A group of persons decide to go to the end of the world to meet the Sun or other supreme god. One (or several) of them perish on their way, some reach destination, at least one returns home using the shorter way than the one they have took before

name: Two wives: the woman and the frog
description: One brother takes a girl, another a frog or toad for a wife, both bring them to their parents, or one man takes two wives, a woman and a frog. Both wives are suggested to pass a test. The girl’s behavior is approved, the frog’s poor qualities are revealed

name: Coyote first betrays and then saves his brother
description: Coyote's brother is victorious against numerous enemies as far as Coyote does not break some taboo. Enemies kill the brother. Coyote gets his remains, escapes, revives him

name: Three maidens
description: Powerful person listens in conversation of three or two women. Each one say what she would do if the person marries her. One promises to bear his son who would have wonderful qualities (or a son and a daughter), two others promise to practice some work or marry other people

name: Children of the youngest wife
description: A young woman promises to bear a wonderful child. In her husband's absence other people (co-wives, mother-in-law, etc.) try to kill the mother and/or the child, usually slandering her

name: Baby child substituted with pup
description: Rivals of the beloved wife hide or throw away her baby and substitute it with an animal (usually with a pup) or object

name: Baby substituted with a broom
description: Rivals of the beloved wife hide or throw away her baby and substitute it with a broom, stone or other inanimate object

name: Innocent woman punished
description: A woman who was falsely accused of killing her new-born child or giving birth to pups and the like is punished in such a way that she must suffer from filth and be taunted by passers by

name: Bird carries baby-girl to its nest
description: A bird carries away a baby-girl, brings her up in its nest, the baby becomes a beautiful girl

name: A younger daughter instead of a son
description: A man who has only daughters needs a son to fulfill the task fit for men (usually to send a son to a prince who needs a soldier). His daughters in succession disguises themselves as men. The elder are scared by dangers and come back but the younger resolves the task. (In Balkan and Caucasus tales the father meets daughters disguised as a robber or a predator animal). See motif F70E

name: Hero, his companions and a dwarf
description: The hero and his companion or companions live together. Every morning one stays at home while another or others go to hunt, etc. A demonic person comes, eats up all the food and beats the cook. Or the man who remained at home comes to the demon himself in search of fire and is maltreated by him. The hero kills or neutralizes the demon

name: Demon claims food and is wounded
description: A demonic person comes to the hero and claims food that the latter possesses or cooks. The hero overcomes and wounds him, follows his trace and comes to his world

name: Bridegroom of the youngest daughter (The loathsome bridegroom)
description: A girl (usually the youngest of several sisters) does not reject but marries a poor, sick, dirty, old, too young, non-human, etc. man who later demonstrates his supernatural qualities

name: Thrown apple hits the chosen one
description: Boy or girl selects one person among many throwing an object (usually an apple) into him or her. This way a girl makes a choice of a husband, a young man of a bride, a boy identifies his father

name: A strange son
description: A boy or (rare) a girl born in family or found by his adoptive parents has strange guise (ball of meat, nut, bag, half of a man, an animal). He or she possesses magic power and usually marries a princess (a prince)

name: Son the frog.
description: An (adoptive) son is a frog. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.

name: Son the snake.
description: An (adoptive) son is a snake. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.

name: Son the gourd.
description: An (adoptive) son is a gourd. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.

name: Son the hedgehog
description: An (adoptive) son is a hedgehog. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.

name: Son the pig
description: An (adoptive) son is a pig. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.

name: Small objects and animals defeat the ogre
description: Small objects and animals (rare: animals alone but including harmless and passive ones, e.g. on the dry land fishes) revenge on a powerful enemy making attack on him in succession (usually they hide in his or her house); the enemy is badly injured, runs away or dies

name: Bremen town musicians
description: Domestic animals get to a place where they meet predators. They frighten them making them to escape

name: Weapons of a goat
description: A predator animal asks a goat (a ram, etc.) about a purpose of certain parts of his body. The goat describes every part as a weapon able to injure his opponent or the goat really possesses weapons

name: Ones who hide in a house frighten dangerous enemy
description: Objects and/or domestic animals live in a house. When dangerous enemy comes, they attack him, he dies or escapes (all texts with K77A and K77B included)

name: Extracted from finger
description: An ogre (an ogress) swallows people, is killed but the people are not found in his or her belly or are found dead. Only when the ogre's finger is cut off, the hero finds a remedy to revive the people or the swallowed up (the swallowed hero himself) come out alive from the finger of the ogre

name: Snake serves an example of resuscitation
description: Person in a desperate situation gets to see how a snake or other small animal uses remedy to revive or to cure itself or other animals. The person uses the remedy, succeeds

name: Person not subject to annihilation
description: Person turns into different objects which another person tries to destroy. Every time a particle of an object remains and undergoes a new metamorphosis. In most case an imposter replaces the true wife or bride and attempts to destroy her but her vital essence passes to different plants and objects. Ultimately the woman acquires her human image again

name: Pipe tells about a murder
description: An object or a creature that emerged from remains, decorations, etc. of a killed person tells about his or her fate. Usually a reed grows from the person's grave and a pipe made from the reed tells the story

name: Killed by the stepmother, eaten up by the father,
description: The (step)mother kills or orders to kill her small (step)son, eats him or feeds his flesh to her husband. The son revives, usually in the form of a bird who tells about the crime.

name: The cranes of Ibycus
description: Person becomes a victim of a murder. Just before dying he or she calls on some birds (animals, celestial bodies, etc.) to bear witness for the crime. Getting to see these birds (the animal, the Moon, etc.) the murderer reveals himself without thinking. Or the birds, being the only witnesses, bring the investigators to the murderers

name: The stuck in pin
description: Person is bewitched (transformed into a bird, faints) when a pin or other sharp object is stuck into her (rare his) body

name: The handless girl
description: For minor offence or because of a false accusation a man maims (rare: kills) a girl or young woman and drives her out of his house or (rare) the girl maims herself. The maimed person magically obtains her body integrity (the dead revives) and is happily married

name: Evil sister-in-law
description: Wife of a man or wives of a group of brothers envy his (their) sister and tries (try) to destroy her

name: The sons on a quest for a wonderful remedy for their father
description: To cure his father (father-in-law, sister) or to make him young again hero must bring a remedy from a distant country. He fulfills the task, the sick person is cured (becomes young)

name: Sisters married to animals
description: Several sisters marry different animals or demons. Usually their husbands help their brother

name: Horses-brothers
description: An antagonist possesses a horse which can overtake any other. Hero obtains the brother (sister) of this horse who is the only one to win the race with the antagonist's horse

name: Weeping child stolen
description: Because a small child is ignored or punished by its parents (usually it cries late in the evening), bush spirit or animal carries it away

name: A stolen boy
description: A forest woman receives or steals a small boy and brings him up to make him her paramour

name: Woman steps into bears’ dung
description: Gathering berries a woman steps into bear's dung and curses bears. A bear abducts her and marries her. Her human husband, her brothers, or supernatural person kill the bears

name: Eyes for food
description: For minor compensation or because of deceit person lets another one to make him blind

name: A girl and a witch: presents of kinsfolk
description: A girl and a witch marry two brothers. Both daughters-in-law have to bring presents from their kinsfolk. The girl finds her brother, brothers or sister whose disappearance was described in the beginning of the tale and receives treasure. Presents brought by the witch worth nothing

name: In search of the place to abandon the sister
description: A girl with her maimed sister or brother escapes from a danger. The sister (brother) rejects some places where the girl wants to abandon her or him but agrees with her last suggestion

name: Brother abandoned in a tree
description: A girl becomes separated with her brothers (or brother) who die, remain in a tree, on a hill, ascend to the sky, etc. After being happily married, the girl once again meets her brothers who have acquired a non-human nature

name: Helpful brother is married to bear
description: A girl parts with her brother or sister who marries a bear and helps the girl

name: The black and the red ones
description: A man gets to see two fighting monsters or animals of contrasted colors (red and black, black and white). He helps one of them and/or one of them helps him

name: Stag antlers stuck in serpent’s throat
description: Antlers of a stag or tusks of an elephant who a serpent tries to swallow are stuck in its throat

name: An invisible battle
description: Hero's dogs or horse or (rare) he himself fight with his adversary in the underworld (under the water). Those who are waiting for the outcome of the combat understand who overcomes whom by the color of water or foam that rises to the surface

name: King Lear
description: A man puts his children questions that seem easy to answer (how they love him, who is the elder in the family, etc.). The elder children flatter, the youngest daughter (rare: son) is reserved and her father drives her away or deprives of inheritance. Later her noble nature becomes evident to him

name: The princess responsible for her own fortune
description: A girl driven away from home or married to a poor man become prosperous

name: Love you like salt
description: A girl answers her father (rare: brother) that she loves him like she loves salt (or that salt is the most valuable, etc.). He becomes angry (usually drives her away) but later satisfies himself that she was right

name: Twin brothers and a woman
description: A twin brother or the best friend follows hero's trace and spends a night in his wife's house but rejects to have sex with her

name: Sword of chastity
description: Sleeping in one bed with a woman, man puts a sharp or thorny object between them as a sign of chastity

name: Bird of luck (eaten up head)
description: Person eats magic bird, fish, small animal, or fruit and becomes prosperous and powerful

name: United in death
description: Two persons (usually two lovers) are buried in one grave or not far from each other. Two plants which grow on this place interweave or smoke of two funeral pyres is merged

name: Fifty sons
description: Many brothers marry or have to marry in such a way that all their wives are (were) sisters

name: Now you are grieved as I was
description: A man is going to kill but spares a giant bird. Later when the bird carries him high in the air he pretends to drop him or to abandon him on a rock. This way the bird wants him to feel the same terror that he felt when the man was going to kill him. Or it is the bird that first drops and picks up a man who later makes the bird feel a similar terror

name: Animal turns into household
description: An animal or (rare) a person that gave birth to the hero or supported him for a long time asks his master to kill him. Its remains turn into a house with a household where the hero can live

name: The sold dream
description: A young man or (rare) a girl has a (day-)dream that predicts his or (rare) her future triumph. The dreamer either conceals or reports its contest to his family and in both cases is punished for too high opinion of himself. In the beginning the dreamer sometimes sells his dream to another young man, who becomes the protagonist of the tale. Adventures that follow explain the contest of the dream. The youth becomes rich and happy (e.g. marries heiresses of two kingdoms, that in the dream were symbolized by two suns or a sun and a moon), the girl marries king's son

name: Father will be attending to his son
description: A man is told that he will be attending to his son or daughter. He drives his son (daughter) away but the prophecy is fulfilled

name: Eloping with the wrong man
description: At night a girl’s lover has to carry her away but falls asleep or is late. She is carried away by another man who happened to be on the place

name: A faithful servant
description: A man gets to know about dangers that threaten his master or his friend of a higher status. He helps his master (friend) to escape the dangers though his own behavior seems strange or hostile. Facing an alternative to be executed or to turn into stone because of revealing the secret, the helper opts for the second. In many cases the master’s child has to be sacrificed to turn the statue back into the man

name: Tobias
description: A young man lets free a fish or an animal that was caught or he or his father renders a help to somebody. When the young man sets off for a journey, the grateful creature or person in guise of a stranger becomes his companion and protector

name: A grateful dead
description: A young man helps to bury a man and / or pays the debts of the dead man lets free a fish or an animal that was caught or he or his father renders a help to somebody. When the young man sets off for a journey, the grateful creature or person in guise of a stranger becomes his companion and protector

name: Snake inside
description: Person (usually a young woman) does not know that a snake lives inside her or him and makes her or him ill or dangerous for other people. {Motif K100C is pretty similar to F9f1 but F9f1 links to a cluster of etiological/cosmological motifs related to the idea of a dangerous woman while K100c is related to adventures}

name: Helpful animal becomes a prince
description: Helpful animal (horse, lion, etc.) asks the hero to kill him and becomes a prince who was this way disenchanted

name: Aggressive stories
description: Stories become harmful because they think that a certain person does not treat them in a correct way

name: Night dances of girls
description: Every morning girl' or (rare) boy’s clothes are in disorder, the boy looks very tied. People spy on her (or on him) and discover that she or he spends nights in the non-human world

name: Demonic paramour of mother or sister
description: A woman who initially is a friend of the hero (his sister or mother) tries to kill him when she becomes allied to a demon whom the hero overcame or (rare) a man who tries to get rid of the hero

name: Father was right
description: A man tells his son to kill his sister, mother, or wife. The young man does not fulfill the order but later regrets about it

name: To ride for the last time
description: A boy or a girl asks permission to ride for the last time his or her favorite animal; then he or she rides away saving his or her life

name: Helpful cow
description: Cow (ox, bull) helps an orphan child or a young woman who got into trouble

name: A red swan
description: The youngest of several brothers remains at home, wounds a red swan or duck, goes away following the bird's trace

name: Wonderful son and rat-children
description: A despised wife gives birth to wonderful human children, other wives give birth to animals

name: Thrown to cows
description: To get rid of a baby child or of the magic cock, they throw him into enclosure for animals, but cows or other animals do not trample the child or cock down

name: Lost husband found
description: A woman is abandoned by her magic husband. She finds him and becomes his wife again

name: Iron shoes to be worn out
